title: Naagini
summary: Naagini (transl. The Female Serpent) is a 2016 Indian Kannada-language supernatural fantasy television series which aired on Zee Kannada. The series, a remake of the Hindi series Naaginn, was directed by Hayavadana. The series premiered on 8 February 2016. Due to its success, a sequel was released on 17 February 2020.

articleSections.title: Summary
articleSections.text:
The series is based on the tale of Ichchadaari Naagini, who avenged the killing of her parents, King Naagaraja (Master Sanjay) and Queen Nagarani (Jayashree Raj), by her enemies for the Naagamani (snake gem). Amrutha (Snake Princess, played by Deepika Das) lives in Takshaka Vana with her parents (the king and queen). Rudra (Arjun Ramesh), his friends and his brother Vishnu went there and killed Amrutha's parents for Naagamani. King Naagaraja's dead body and the Naagamani are secretly under the control of Rudra's elder brother Vishnu.
After ten years, her aunt advised Amrutha to go to Durgapura Shiva temple. She complies, taking her deceased mother. Arjun (Dheekshith Shetty), the adopted son of Vishnu, is an innocent boy who loves Amrutha. Vikram and Saroja adopted Amrutha as their daughter. Rudra and Baba try to kill the Nagarani. Amrutha kills the first murderer, Raju, in an incomplete apartment building. Amrutha is befriended by the Snake Shesha. Amrutha learns that Rudra, his brother and his friends are the culprits. She marries Arjun. At the wedding ceremony, Shesha is killed by Rudra, Vishnu and Baba. Then Amrutha kills the second murderer, Prakash. She learns that Triveni is not the mother of Rudra and Vishnu. Triveni killed Arjun's relative and She is not a good woman her real identity is unknown. She hails from naga clan like Amrutha and want naagmani. Naagamani is hidden in Shivalingam that was made at Takshaka Vana by Gurudeva. Triveni's real name is Damayanthi and Arjun's real name is Partha, a secret known only by the Gurudev. Lord Karthikeya gives life back to Shesha for helping Amrutha. Amrutha kills the third murderer Rudra at Garuda temple. Later, Shesha betrays Amrutha for Arjun. Triveni hates Amrutha so she supports Mayuri to marry Amrutha.

articleSections.title: Goraknath
articleSections.text:
A professor and researcher tries to capture Naagini for revenge. He is threatened by her when he is following her in snake form to know Naagamani. He goes to a tantrik to gain special powers. He sends his goons to capture snakes. Gurudev decides to give life to King Nagaraj for helping Amrutha. Gurudeva inserts his soul into King Maharaja's body and gives life back to King Naagaraj.
Naagini goes to the forest, sees them and tries to free the snakes. She takes the form of a snake and hides in boxes in their vehicles, to know the truth. Goraknath said the snakes would be shipped to Andaman because he has go to Andaman. Accidentally Amrutha takes Naagini into Andaman. Arjun unsuccessfully searches for Amrutha, then finally goes to Andaman, meets his friend Nanda to get help from him, and they find Amrutha.
Goraknath captures Naagini and imprisons her. Arjun rescues her. Amrutha and Arjun run from Gora's place. Gora targets Arjun to capture Naagini. While Arjun is driving his car, Gora uses his power to make Arjun unconscious, and he crashes. Naagaraja takes him to the Ashram for treatment. Triveni and Amritha are informed about the accident. Later the family is informed about the accident and take him to the hospital. Poornachandra Shastri advises them to make a yajnyaa pooja to save him.
Shastriji starts the pooja and advises Amrutha that she can bring special sanjeevini mulika which can save him. Amrutha goes to the mountain, assisted by Nagaraja. He takes sanjivini and saves Arjun. Later, Goraknath is defeated by Bhaira and Baba.

articleSections.title: Rudra
articleSections.text:
Rudra is alive. Earlier, Amrutha killed him by Lord Kaali's power. He is later saved by the Naagamani power. Triveni asks Jyotishi about Rudra. They advise that Rudra was resurrected by his father, Jathaka. Rudra comes to their family, but he acts like a child, without memory. Vishnu goes to Bhairava Baba to know the truthwho reveals that Rudra was saved by the Naagamani power.
Rudra gets the Naagamani. He tries to kill Amrutha by taking several forms, but Naagini is helped by Poornachandra Shastri to save him. Bhairava knows the Naagamani is in Rudra's hand and tries to take it. Rudra imprisons Vishnu and hides him. Triveni and her family are bothered by Vishnu's absence. Rudra sends a man and he says that Arjun and Amrutha have to go to Vishnupura to save Vishnu.

articleSections.title: Triveni
articleSections.text:
The family's head Triveni's real name is Damayanti and comes from the Naaga clan. She adopts Arjun as their son. Only she knows the truth that Arjun is Naagayoda.
Arjun was born with mixed divine and naga powers, incarnated for protecting Naagamani. Triveni knows the secret and takes him to their family. Her naaga guru tells him that after Arjun completes 25 years, he transforms into a Nagayoda, a powerful mahanaga.
Episodes:
"Kanishka's attack" - When Kanishka imprisoned Amrutha, Arjun becomes a Nagayoda and protects Naagini from Kanishka. * "Goraknath's episodes in Andaman" - Arjun becomes Naagayoda and fights the goons who were guarding Amrutha and escapes from the island.

articleSections.title: Vishnupura and Garuda Vamsha
articleSections.text:
A village named Vishnupura worships Garuda. The Shatrughna of the village, from Garudavamsha, plans to reopen the Garuda Temple. The pujari decide to make mahapooja.
Following Rudra's plan, Arjun and Amrutha go to perform pooja in Vishnupura. The village Shatrughna started performing yajnya and send his sister Sowparnika to make digbandhana. Arjun and Amrutha arrive, but she does not welcome them. Arjun saves her when her rival tries to attack her to disturb the pooja. She gives them permission to enter the village and takes them to their place. Arjun and Amrutha approach the yajnya and disturb it and Shatrughna tries to punish them. Sowparnika said that they saved her from her rival's attack pooja. Arjun and Amrutha stay in Shatrughna's home. Rudra comes to Vishnupura and convinces Shatrughna that Amrutha is Naagini.
The Shatrughna and Rudra use Arjun to capture Amrutha. Amrutha is assisted by Sowparnika to save Arjun. Triveni is tense about what's happening in Vishnupura. He visits there and sees that Rudra is normal. He says "he has acted that way to kill his enemy". Triveni tries to convince him that Arjun is not naaga. After Vishnu Bhairava Baba and Shastriji, Shastri acts as enemy and tries to help Amrutha and Arjun.
Bhairava Baba and Rudra capture Amrutha and try to kill her. Arjun takes Naga form to rescue Amrutha and swallows Nagamani. Amrutha defeats Bhairava and Rudra. Finally Vishnu returns with Arjun's help.
Arjun starts to get signs of naaga when he is angered. Arjun tries to punish and warn Vishnu for killing naagas. Vishnu learns of this and goes to Bhairava to save him. He advises him to give Arjun to Bali pooja in order to save him. Vishnu tries to kill Arjun before Arjun kills him. He sends him Kaalingapura. When Vishnu tries, he accidentally sees his naaga form. Rudra goes there and takes him home.
Vishnu tells Rudra of the event, but Rudra did not believe him. Arjun takes naga form and chases Vishnu. Vishnu runs out to save a life. Rudra approaches Vishnu. The duo is killed by Arjun's naaga form. Bhairava gives them their lives back. Vishnu and Rudra tell Bhairava of the incident, but he does not believe it. Once Bhairva tests Arjuna in their home and concludes that Arjun is naga and has Naagamani. Bhairva tries to take Nagamani from him but defeated by Arjun.
Bhairva Baba concludes and tells Vishnu and Rudra that it is impossible for them but a rival of him would kill him. That rival is an Apsara named Urmila, aspiring to take Naagamani from Arjun. They killed Shesha also by tricking her in Amrutha form.

articleSections.title: Entry of Apsara
articleSections.text:
Amrutha and Arjun go on a trip, but a mystical old apsara takes them to an old temple. Amrutha knows Shesha's death by the trio of Vishnu, Rudra and Bhairava, chases them, kills Vishnu and Rudra, and accidentally takes them in Naga Roopa's body. Bhairav domslsEraser follows and asks for his advice. His guru said that he will defeat erasers with a weapon from his guru's atma Shakti. He would use it twice. Bhairava first uses the weapon when she released Vishnu and Rudra. The second time, she loses her sight. Bhairava tells the duo that Naagini has lost her sight, if she does not have treatment for her sight, she will give up her life. Arjun arrives and takes Amrutha home. The duo try to say that Amrutha is Naagini, but Arjun saves her.
Then, eraser controls Amrutha's mind and makes her say she needs ayurveda treatment. Eraser plans to kill Arjun and sends him to a village by disguising as an astrologer, saying he has to visit a village named Pushpagiri for Amrutha's treatment. There Amrutha starts to possess Arjun. Triveni and Urvashi try to test to reveal her as Naagini. Arjun becomes possessed by her.
In Arjun's absence, Amrutha's true identity is revealed to everyone and Amrutha is thrown from the home. When Arjun arrives, he is told she is missing. He tries to find Amrutha. Meanwhile, Triveni takes the form of Gudi, a girl whom the family members wish to marry Arjun to turn him back to human.
Amrutha blesses Vaishnavi and Kumar to get a child. Dakshayani, Kumar's mother, gets to know that Amrutha is Naagini. She instructs Amrutha to perform Shiv-Parvati Pooja to save Arjun from Urmila.
When celebrating Naagarpanchami, Arjun meets Amrutha and she decides to take him to Naagloka, but her plan is foiled and she loses Arjun. Amrutha begins the pooja by begging for money. Triveni is captured by Bhairava and becomes his companion. Gudi plans to take Arjun to Amrutha .
Bhairava suddenly tells the family members to marry Arjuna and Triveni. Shastri escapes with Arjun. He takes Arjun to the forest to meet Amrutha. He leaves Arjun with Amrutha. Bhairava sends Kanishka to get the Naagmani where he is killed by Amrutha. On Neela Amavasya, the Neeli Nagas wrapped on Arjun where Naagmani was hidden. Later Amrutha confirms Naagmani's location.

articleSections.title: Naagini Antima Adhyaya
articleSections.text:
Amrutha learns that Nagamani is inside Arjun. As per Shastri's instruction Amrutha and Arjun unite as snakes in front of Shivalinga and the Nagamani inside Arjun comes out and goes on top of Shivalinga. Shastry says to Hema that a valuable object must be collected and she must keep it with her for a few days. Hema arrives and takes Naagmani and escapes. Amrutha comes back as human and identifies that Naagmani is missing. Then she asks Shastry about it. Shastry says that it is with Hema. Amrutha demands Hema for Naagmani, but Hema restricts her by giving Naagmani and says that the condition was that Amrutha should give Arjun to Hema and he should marry Triveni. Then she will give Naagmani to her. Amrutha agrees to that and brings Arjun home. Hema begs Amrutha that, she should leave the house by leaving Arjun and Arjun should come to know that she is Naagini. As per Hema's instructions, Amrutha tries to kill Mani as a Naagini. Arjun learns that Amrutha is Naagini so he throws Amrutha out.
Triveni reveals to Amrutha and says that she is a Naagini, not a ghost. And that she came on earth to marry Arjun. Amrutha challenges her that she take Arjun to Naaglok for Vasuki Dynasty, not for Urmila's Takshaka Dynasty.
Arjun's family decides to marry Arjun with Urmila and takes them to temple where marry. But Amrutha had disguised herself as Urmila. Amrutha arrests Urmila and hands her to Shastry. Shastry makes Urmila a statue and then Amrutha disguises as Urmila and marries Arjun.
Arjun is not happy and badly needs Amrutha whether she is Naagini or human. Hema and Amrutha (disguised as Urmila) goes to Ashrama. Shastry tells Hema to hand Naagmani to Urmila (Amrutha) as he know that Urmila is Amrutha. So Hema gives the box of Naagmani to Amrutha, but it was Bhairava Baba, who appeared to be Amrutha. Hema learns that she has lost Naagmani. Amrutha asks Shastry about this Shastry says that she should kill one of her enemies.

articleSections.title: Rebirth of Arjun
articleSections.text: Arjun is reborn as Ajanubhava (an infectious snake). He is born as a human. His grandmother says he was an Ajanubhava. He does not believe in supernatural powers. He ignores his grandmother. Agrahara, a Bhairava, puts a Nagabhandhana. It was proved he was a snake. Bhairava tortures Ajanubhava and his father-in-law goes to Puttahamsa. A Mujyaala tells Vishnu not to travel to Naagara Devasthana. Vishnu and Rudra push Mujyaala and enter Naagara Devasthana. Ajanubhava is converted into naagayodha and save Naagara Devasthana. He defeats Vishnu and Rudra.

articleSections.title: Defeat of Thakshaka
articleSections.text: Bhairava converts the spirit of Naagayodha. Thakshaka helps Amrutha but he does not get Vajrahana. Bhairava decides to get a poisonous snake. Thakshaka gets angry and kills a snake. Bhairava is not able to defeat Thakshaka. He remembers that in the past he had challenged Thakshaka that he would become more powerful than him. Bhairava stands against Thakshaka but is defeated. Naagayodha, an evil spirit, later defeats Thakshaka.

articleSections.title: Characters
articleSections.text: Amruta: She is an Ichadaari Naagini and the daughter of the king and queen of Naaglok. Also, the adoptive daughter Vikram and Saroja. * Shesha: She is an Ichchadaari Naagini made by Gurudev for helping Amrutha. She looks exactly like Amrutha. A big mole on her neck distinguishes her. She is the best friend of Amrutha. . * Arjun: Arjun is the husband of Amrutha. He is an adopted son of Vishnu and Hema and the son of an unknown deceased father and mother Yasodha. His real name is Partha and his real identity is unknown. * Raju: He is the first murderer of King and Queen of Naaglok. * Prakash: He is the second murderer of King and Queen of Naaglok. * Rudra: He is the third and main murderer of King and Queen of Naaglok and the first murderer of Shesha. He was the adopted son of Triveni. * Bairava Baba: He is the second murderer of Shesha and motivated all to steal Naagmani. He is the guru of Vishnu and Rudra. He is a greedy sorcerer. * Vishnu: He is the adopted son of Triveni and the brother of Rudra. He is the third murderer of Shesha. He is greedy to get the Naagmani. * Triveni: She was the adopted mother of Vishnu and Rudra. Her identity is unknown. She brings Arjun and returns to Vishnu. Her real name was Damayanthi. * Karan: He is the step-brother of Arjun and he is jealous of Naagmani. * Chitra: She is the wife of Karan. * Gurudev: He is a devotee of Lord Parameshwara. * Mayuri: Mayuri is a modern girl who is in love with Arjun. But she also craves his family's wealth. * Harsha: Harsha is Mayuri's friend and he lies to and deceives girls. * Hemavathi: She is called Hema for short and is the wife of Vishnu and stepmother of Arjun. She is a loving and care-taking woman. * Vani: Vani is the wife of Rudra. She is also a loving and care-taking woman.

cast.name: Amruta: She is an Ichadaari Naagini and the daughter of the king and queen of Naaglok. Also, the adoptive daughter Vikram and Saroja.
Shesha: She is an Ichchadaari Naagini made by Gurudev for helping Amrutha. She looks exactly like Amrutha. A big mole on her neck distinguishes her. She is the best friend of Amrutha. .
Arjun: Arjun is the husband of Amrutha. He is an adopted son of Vishnu and Hema and the son of an unknown deceased father and mother Yasodha. His real name is Partha and his real identity is unknown.
Raju: He is the first murderer of King and Queen of Naaglok.
Prakash: He is the second murderer of King and Queen of Naaglok.
Rudra: He is the third and main murderer of King and Queen of Naaglok and the first murderer of Shesha. He was the adopted son of Triveni.
Bairava Baba: He is the second murderer of Shesha and motivated all to steal Naagmani. He is the guru of Vishnu and Rudra. He is a greedy sorcerer.
Vishnu: He is the adopted son of Triveni and the brother of Rudra. He is the third murderer of Shesha. He is greedy to get the Naagmani.
Triveni: She was the adopted mother of Vishnu and Rudra. Her identity is unknown. She brings Arjun and returns to Vishnu. Her real name was Damayanthi.
Karan: He is the step-brother of Arjun and he is jealous of Naagmani.
Chitra: She is the wife of Karan.
Gurudev: He is a devotee of Lord Parameshwara.
Mayuri: Mayuri is a modern girl who is in love with Arjun. But she also craves his family's wealth.
Harsha: Harsha is Mayuri's friend and he lies to and deceives girls.
Hemavathi: She is called Hema for short and is the wife of Vishnu and stepmother of Arjun. She is a loving and care-taking woman.
Vani: Vani is the wife of Rudra. She is also a loving and care-taking woman.

title: Naagin
summary:
Naagin (transl. Female serpent) is an Indian supernatural fiction television series about shape-shifting serpents produced by Ekta Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms.
The first season aired from 1 November 2015 to 5 June 2016. It starred Mouni Roy, Arjun Bijlani and Adaa Khan.
The second season aired from 8 October 2016 to 25 June 2017. It starred Mouni Roy, Karanvir Bohra, Adaa Khan, Kinshuk Mahajan and Sudha Chandran.
The third season aired from 2 June 2018 to 26 May 2019. It starred Surbhi Jyoti, Pearl V Puri, Anita Hassanandani and Rajat Tokas.
The fourth season titled Naagin: Bhagya Ka Zehreela Khel premiered on 14 December 2019, its telecast was halted from 22 March 2020 due to COVID-19 outbreak and restarted on 18 July 2020 and ended on 8 August 2020. It starred Nia Sharma, Vijayendra Kumeria, Jasmin Bhasin, Anita Hassanandani and Rashami Desai.
The fifth season aired from 9 August 2020 to 6 February 2021. It starred Surbhi Chandna, Sharad Malhotra and Mohit Sehgal.
The sixth season aired from 12 February 2022 to 9 July 2023 and starred Tejasswi Prakash, Simba Nagpal, Mahek Chahal, Pratik Sehajpal, Shrey Mittal and Vatsal Sheth.
The seventh season aired from 27 December 2025 to 14 June 2026. It starred Priyanka Chahar Choudhary and Namik Paul.
The eighth season is scheduled to release in 2027.
reception:
In its launch week, the series topped the ratings charts. Season One proved to be highly successful.
The second season also topped the ratings chart in its launch week and continued to do so.
Like the first 2 seasons, the third season also topped the ratings chart in its launch week and continued to do so for several months. But when the 3rd season was extended in January 2019, the season lost its top position in the TRP charts and even went out of the top 5 shows for several months but regained its top position in the last week.
The fourth season topped the rating charts for 2 months and later managed to remain in top 5 shows. However, because of the lockdown, the season's original story was scrapped and it had to wrap up within 8 episodes post lockdown since it was not as successful like the previous seasons.
Unlike previous seasons which consistently maintained its positions in top 5, season 5 since its respective third week of telecast, wasn't able to enter the top 5 Hindi GEC while its ratings dropped weekly. The ratings of the season dropped to an all-time low.
The sixth season had a successful 2 months, but later on, met with slight fluctuations in ratings due to time slot changes. It got multiple extensions due to its success and became the longest-running season of the franchise.
The seventh season debuted strongly and initially ranked among the top-rated Hindi television programmes, even reaching the number one position during its early weeks. However, ratings declined over time and the season later dropped out of the top five.

episodesList.title: A Mysterious Woman Haunts Ritik
episodesList.summary: Rithik follows a woman in his dream and the woman turns into a snake and bites him. His mother is informed that only Rithik's marriage can save him from the impending danger.

episodesList.title: The Naagin Begins With Her Revenge Plan
episodesList.summary: Rithik's engagement at the Haveli faces unexpected obstacles. Meanwhile, the Naagins, Sesha and Shivanya, are finally free to take any form after 20 years.

episodesList.title: Sesha's Truth Revealed?
episodesList.summary: Sesha reaches the mansion disguised as a dancer and mixes poison in the drinks but no one is harmed. Yamini finds Sesha turning into a snake.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Re-enters The House
episodesList.summary: Tanvi and Hrithik's engagement is underway when Shivanya re-enters Hrithik's house with the help of Sesha. She intends to avenge her parent's death.

episodesList.title: Viren's Attempts to Get Intimate With Shivanya
episodesList.summary: Shivanya confronts Viren's advances at the Raheja house.  Ritwik rescues her from Viren's blackmail, leading to a blossoming romance between Shivanya and Ritwik.

episodesList.title: The Truth About Hrithik's Horoscope
episodesList.summary: Ankush and Yamini find a shocking poster and hide it. Hrithik claims he's marrying Tanvi for her happiness but Yamini reveals the truth about his horoscope.

episodesList.title: Conflict At The Wedding Ceremony.
episodesList.summary: Shivanya's bite thwarts Tanvi's wedding. Yamini's stunned reaction to Shivanya as the bride ignites Shivanya's revenge, forcing Yamini to accept her marriage to Rithik.

episodesList.title: A Marriage Made In Heaven
episodesList.summary: Hritik's mother arranges his marriage to Shivanya, who saved his life, instead of his beloved Tanvi. Hritik, despite his love for Shivanya, offers her freedom.

episodesList.title: An Unexpected Blessing For Shivanya
episodesList.summary: Yogiraj's blessing guides Shivanya towards love, not revenge. Meanwhile, Ankush's visions unveil Suri as the fourth culprit.

episodesList.title: Naagin Unleashed
episodesList.summary: A servant's discovery of a snake skin near the temple prompts the priest to burn it, hoping to draw the snake out. Sesha fears for Shivanya's safety and prays for her protection.

episodesList.title: Sesha to Kill Suri
episodesList.summary: Shivanya suspects Suri in her parents' death, noticing his six fingers. But Shesha, impatient, plans to kill him at the airport.

episodesList.title: Naagin's Vengance
episodesList.summary: Tanvi tells her parents that she heard Shivanya talk about revenge. Later, as Sushim informs Ankush about the Naagin's return. Shesha and Shivanya overhear their conversation.

episodesList.title: Naagin Ploys Killers Against Each Other
episodesList.summary: Shivanya takes the form of an astrologer named Ramya and warns the killers. Later, Sesha takes the form of Monisha and tricks Sailesh into seducing the real Monisha.

episodesList.title: Naagin's Close Escape
episodesList.summary: Rithik reveals his love for Shivanya, but Tanvi questions her. Guruma uses magic against Sesha, who plots Suri's death in the temple.

episodesList.title: Will Shivanya Attend The Mahakali Puja?
episodesList.summary: Suri's shock: Shivanya's at the temple! Guruma orders a 'Mahakali Puja' to expel the 'naagin', forcing Shivanya and Rithik to participate.

episodesList.title: Ritik is Poisoned
episodesList.summary: Shivanya saves Ritik from the poison given by Sesha. Later, Sesha prays for a storm which endangers Ankush's and his family's life.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Fights Mahakali
episodesList.summary: Kali Ma possesses a young girl and kills Sesha. Later, Shivanya uses the idol of Lord Shiva and pleads to Kali Ma to give back the lives she has taken.

episodesList.title: Naagin Enters The Haveli
episodesList.summary: Shivanya persuades Goddess Kali to side with the innocent snakes. Shivanya and Ritik go to the old Haveli; Sesha disrupts Guruma's prayers and bites her.

episodesList.title: Dewvdi's Secret
episodesList.summary: Shivanya and Ritik face strange happenings at the old mansion. Guruma traps Sesha in the cave. Back home, Yamini and Ankush confront them.

episodesList.title: Sesha and Shivanya Wins Yet Again.
episodesList.summary: Guruma traps Sesha. Shivanya, bitten by a snake, begs Rithik to take her to Gurumaa.  While Rithik and Gurumaa seek herbs, Shivanya rescues Sesha from the cave.

episodesList.title: The Wrong Locket.
episodesList.summary: Shivanya's secret visit to the Naagin temple is discovered by Yamini. Shesha steps in to save the day by switching lockets. Meanwhile, Kabir arrives at Ankush's to see Thanvi.

episodesList.title: Sesha Plans to Kill Sailesh Mathur
episodesList.summary: Sesha, disguised as Ankur, steals Sailesh's ring at the Kya Kool Hain Hum-3 premiere. She lures him to Shiv Mandir, setting the stage for a deadly plot with Shivanya.

episodesList.title: Kabir Kills Tanvi.
episodesList.summary: Tanvi sees Shivanya and Shesha transforming into serpents. Kabir transforms into a big Mongoose in front of Tanvi and kills her. The fake Kabir kills the real Kabir.

episodesList.title: Kabir Tries to Kill Shivanya.
episodesList.summary: Rithik grieves over Tanvi's death. Kabir tries to kill Shivanya but Gurudev saves her. Sesha and Shivanya want to find the mongoose. Kabir traps Sesha.

episodesList.title: Shivanya and Sesha Kill Kabir
episodesList.summary: Rithik tells Shivanya that he saw a dream about a diamond. Shivanya takes Kabir's watch to Guruji. A masked man comes and kills Suri's wife.

episodesList.title: Nagapanchami Day
episodesList.summary: Monisha is shot by a stranger. Shesha suspects Rithvik, but the truth is revealed - Ankush is the killer.  Nagapanchami rituals unfold in Ankush's house.

episodesList.title: Shivanya is Stabbed
episodesList.summary: Shivanya, poisoned by a dagger, fights for survival as Gurudev attempts a cure. Sesha, her transformed clone, discovers a mark on Ritik that echoes a legend in the book "Naagmani."

episodesList.title: Shivanya's Journey Through The Dark Forest
episodesList.summary: Shivanya and Shesha, vengeful ichchadari naagins, seek retribution for their parents' murder at the hands of Ankush, Viren, and others.

episodesList.title: Guruma Looses All Her Powers
episodesList.summary: Guruma's failed attacks leave the Naagin vulnerable. She races to the Rahejas for help, while Gurudev unveils the Naagmani's power to revive Shivanya.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Shivanya reunites with a Sesha-controlled Ritik. Rejecting his enchanted love, she forces him away, defying Remya's accusations of being a Naagin, confirmed false by Guruma.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Gets Her Powers Back
episodesList.summary: Katak and Sesha restore Shivanya's powers through ancient rituals. Lord Krishna intervenes, granting her strength. She exacts revenge on Shailesh and his men.

episodesList.title: Ritik Witnesses The Killing Of Shailesh
episodesList.summary: Shivanya's resurrected powers claim Shailesh's life. Traumatized Ritik alerts the family, leaving them shocked. Sesha aids Shivanya in retrieving the Mang Tika.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Invokes The Naagmani
episodesList.summary: Shivanya dances to awaken the naagmani, while Sesha fights to keep Ritik and Guruma away. Ankush seeks the naagmani, but the Naagins stand guard.

episodesList.title: Yamini Tries to Steal Nagmani
episodesList.summary: Yamini's attempt to steal the Nagmani from the cave fails as the auspicious time passes. She postpones her plan. Meanwhile, Shivanya rescues an unconscious Ritik from the temple.

episodesList.title: Sangram Singh Escapes From The Cave
episodesList.summary: Sangram Singh, after running away from the cave, decides to find his son at any cost. Later, he reveals that he never expected his sister Yamini to betray him and wreck his life.

episodesList.title: The Serpent's Gem
episodesList.summary: Manipulated by Yamini, Rithik seeks the serpent's gem, while Sesha and Shivanya try to stop him. But Yamini's betrayal sends Maharaj Sangram Singh to his death.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Saves Ritik's Life
episodesList.summary: Shivanya hunts her parents' killer, but the Naag mani yields no clues. Ankush attacks Ritik, thwarted by Shivanya. Sesha finds Ritik's father and the Naag mani missing.

episodesList.title: The Mystery Of The Naagmani
episodesList.summary: Guruma introduces Mayuri, her new assistant, to lure Ritik. Meanwhile, Sesha investigates the Naagmani, following in her father's footsteps.

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Powers Of Mayuri
episodesList.summary: Mayuri reveals Shesha's true form to Yamini, using a mirror and her powers.  Later, she mysteriously injures Shivanya to further expose her identity.

episodesList.title: The Duel Between Shesha and Mayuri
episodesList.summary: Shesha confronts Mayuri for secretly attacking Shivanya and tries to kill her. However, Mayuri defeats Shesha in the fight and holds her captive in an attempt to seize the nagmani.

episodesList.title: Mahishmati Race to Destroy Human Race
episodesList.summary: Sangram Singh reads an ancient book and learns that Mahishmati race is on its way to destroy the human race. Meanwhile when Mayuri captures Shesha, she gets killed by Shivanya.

episodesList.title: Finding The Fifth Murderer
episodesList.summary: Yamini's treachery is exposed when Ritik (Shesha) attacks Sangram. Shivanya, as Sangram, confronts Yamini, demanding the fifth killer's name. Yamini retaliates with accusations.

episodesList.title: The Aghoris Capture Shivanya
episodesList.summary: Shivanya, while shopping, is abducted by Aghoris and tortured in a fiery ordeal.  She loses her Mangalsutra, while Sesha's love for Ritik deepens.

episodesList.title: Ritik The Saviour
episodesList.summary: Sesha joins Shivanya's fight against the Aghoris, but gets trapped. Ritik arrives with the police, saving them and the other serpents.

episodesList.title: Yamini Plots Yet Again
episodesList.summary: Yamini manipulates Ankush to get a Naagin killed. Her tears and cunning scheme turn Shivanya against Ankush. Will they see through her deceit?

episodesList.title: Dangerous Omens
episodesList.summary: Shivanya's heartbreak deepens as Sesha nearly marries Ritik, but Ankush's arrest and Yamini's temple discovery of an unconscious Guru Maa disrupt the chaos. Sangram foresees doom.

episodesList.title: Yamini's Truth is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Shivanya chases Yamini, thief of the powerful Naagmani, into a cavern. Will Shivanya stop Yamini before she claims ultimate power?

episodesList.title: Sesha Cohorts With Yamini
episodesList.summary: Sesha and Yamini combine forces to attain the Nagmani. Later, they attempt to kill Shivanya and stop her from being a hurdle. Will they succeed in incapacitating her?

episodesList.title: Shivanya is Trapped
episodesList.summary: Shivanya, posing as Sesha, tries to seduce Ritik, but her secret's out. Fleeing Guru Maa, she must reveal a shocking truth about his parents. Will he believe her?

episodesList.title: Shivanya Confronts Sesha
episodesList.summary: Ritik's world shatters when Yamini exposes Shivanya's secret. Sesha attacks, and Yamini tricks Ritik into killing Shivanya to save their family. Can love survive?

episodesList.title: Yamini's Killing Spree
episodesList.summary: Yamini murders Shivanya, then throws Ritik into the sea. Resurrected by the shivling, Shivanya rescues Ritik. Can she find the Nagamani to save him?

episodesList.title: Ritik is Resurrected
episodesList.summary: Shivanya uses the Naagmani to save Ritik and reunite him with his father. Sesha's freedom comes at Guru Dev's cost. Yamini's evil catches up to her.

episodesList.title: Yamini Loses Her Mind
episodesList.summary: Yamini, armed and ready, hears of Ritik's return. But Ritik's fate is tied to protecting the Naagamani, not becoming a Naag. Will Shivanya finally find justice?

episodesList.title: The Sacrilegious Union
episodesList.summary: Guru Maa's dark magic summons a deadly tornado, trapping Ritik and Shivanya in ice. Ritik's rescue leads to intimacy, but at what cost?

episodesList.title: Sangram Gets Shot
episodesList.summary: Sesha's theft of the Naagmani is thwarted by Shivanya, only for Sangram (under Guru Maa's control) to steal it. A gunfight leaves Sangram wounded.

episodesList.title: Kabeer Returns to Kill Naagin
episodesList.summary: Bee-stung Sangram seeks revenge on Ritik, turning evil. Meanwhile, Kabir returns to fight the Naagins, allying with Sesha. Their shared hatred masks deeper, personal vendettas.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Comes Face to Face With Kabir
episodesList.summary: Sesha, disguised as Remya, leads Shivanya to her room. Kabir, lured by Sesha, enters to kill Shivanya. Will Ritik save her?

episodesList.title: Viren Gets Shot
episodesList.summary: Yamini finds Ritik faked-imprisoned by a Naagin. He escapes to save Shivanya, leading to a showdown with Viren and the police, ending in Viren's shooting.

episodesList.title: Shivanya Seeks Sesha's Help
episodesList.summary: A deadly attack by Sesha turns Shivanya into a snake. Kabir, a mongoose, fights Sesha, then kidnaps Ritik. Shivanya must make a dangerous deal with Sesha for Ritik's rescue.

episodesList.title: Shivanya and Sesha Kill Kabir
episodesList.summary: Shivanya and Sesha defeat Kabir, freeing Ritik. But Yamini and Sesha plot to reignite the ancient Chandravanshi-Suryavanshi feud. Can Shivanya stop them?

episodesList.title: The Wrath Of Kali Maa
episodesList.summary: Shivanya and Ritik's ritual to summon Kali Maa is interrupted by Yamini's attack. But Shivanya gains the goddess's power. Will Yamini face the wrath of Kali Maa?

episodesList.title: The Battle For The Naagmani Reaches Fever Pitch
episodesList.summary: Ritik and Shivanya face their ultimate challenge as Queen Avantika and Sesha join forces against them, threatening to steal the Naagmani.

episodesList.title: Manyataa On The Run!
episodesList.summary: To marry Keshav, Manyataa abandons her powers. Revenge follows, leaving her child as her only hope. Will they survive?

episodesList.title: Manyataa-Nayantara's Quest For Revenge!
episodesList.summary: Naagin Nayantara and her mother plot slow revenge on the Parekhs for Keshav's death. Their first target?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Lays a Wicked Trap!
episodesList.summary: Nayantara isolates Dev. Can he escape her clutches before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Plans to Expose Dev!
episodesList.summary: Nayantara's revenge plot against the Parikhs takes a sinister turn. Targeting Dev's grandmother, she aims to expose his hidden serpent identity. Will her scheme succeed?

episodesList.title: Manyataa Awaits Her Vengeance!
episodesList.summary: Twenty-five years of plotting culminates. Mother & daughter Naagins seek vengeance.

episodesList.title: A Dilemma For Manyata
episodesList.summary: Manyata's daughter's failure delays her revenge. Will she uncover the reason and ultimately succeed?

episodesList.title: Manyata Struggles For Answers!
episodesList.summary: Seeking answers, Manyata discovers the Saprkosh's location: the Mayaavi Registaan. Her perilous journey starts.

episodesList.title: Manyata Gets Access to The Sarpkosh!
episodesList.summary: Across hills and plains, Manyata reaches the Sarpkosh; will it reveal her daughter's identity?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Vows to Destroy Brinda!
episodesList.summary: Brinda's secret threatens Nayantara, who plots deadly revenge. Manyata misses a crucial sign. Nayantara's actions spiral.

episodesList.title: Will Nayantara's Plan Bear Fruit?
episodesList.summary: Nayantara's flute compels Brinda to transform into her Naagin form, granting her control.  Will she succeed in leading Brinda to her fiery demise, or will Dev intervene?

episodesList.title: Brinda's Heartfelt Request to Dev!
episodesList.summary: Humiliated, Brinda schemes to marry Dev off, hoping to escape the fallout. Will her plan succeed?

episodesList.title: Brinda Turns Icchadhari Naagin!
episodesList.summary: Naagin Brinda intervenes as Manyata seeks revenge on the Parekh family. Will she save them or join the fight?

episodesList.title: Brinda to Help Manyata!
episodesList.summary: Nayantara's secret's out. Manyata needs Brinda's help to protect her daughter from the vengeful Parekhs.

episodesList.title: Nayantara On The Run!
episodesList.summary: The Parekhs hunt Nayantara after she escapes with Manyata's help. Will she survive their attack?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Falls Off The Cliff!
episodesList.summary: Wronged by Dev's family, Brinda vows revenge after her sister's murder.

episodesList.title: Brinda Seeks an Eye For an Eye!
episodesList.summary: A marriage proposal masks revenge. Can Dev & Brinda's families overcome this deception?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Eyes The Naagin Powers!
episodesList.summary: Nayantara seeks Vish's help to become a Naagin and defeat Brinda. The Naagmani is the key, but can she acquire it?

episodesList.title: A Deceitful Trap For Brinda!
episodesList.summary: Faced with ultimate sacrifice, Brinda seeks Manyata. Vishaka's help is a deceptive trap. Will Brinda uncover her betrayal?

episodesList.title: Vishaka Deceives Brinda!
episodesList.summary: Missing father, police arrive. Brinda's secret's exposed, but Vishaka saves her. Will Brinda trust this savior blindly?

episodesList.title: Brinda Gets a Divine Vision!
episodesList.summary: Manyata's missing from her Lal Tekdi prison cell. Brinda's vision led her there, but who thwarted her rescue?

episodesList.title: Naagin Ka Sach Aaya Bahar!
episodesList.summary: Brinda's revenge plan against Dev unravels when he catches her in the act. Their conflict escalates.

episodesList.title: Vishaka's Diabolic Plan!
episodesList.summary: Brinda hunts for Manyata, tricked by Vishaka. Jealous Dev witnesses the deception. Vishaka's goal revealed.

episodesList.title: Vishaka to End Dev's Life?
episodesList.summary: Deception and murder fuel Vishaka's quest for the Nagmani. Will Brinda save Dev from her deadly plot?

episodesList.title: Dev Defends Brinda's Honour!
episodesList.summary: Truth bombshell: Brinda's pregnancy announcement is upended by Vishaka's shocking gender change and paternity claim.

episodesList.title: Brinda to The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Vishaka's goons kidnap Dev. Brinda, fueled by fury, takes on the kidnappers alone. Can she save her husband?

episodesList.title: Brinda Loses Manyata!
episodesList.summary: Naagmani theft leads Brinda to believe Dev is the culprit. Vishaka frames Dev, harming Manyata. Who is Brinda's true enemy?

episodesList.title: Nayantara Becomes Shalakha!
episodesList.summary: Vishaka's magic transforms Nayantara into her ally. Brinda's power is their only hope.

episodesList.title: Brinda Returns to Dev!
episodesList.summary: Dev's Holi joy shatters as Brinda reveals their marriage, still valid.

episodesList.title: Brinda Threatens to Kill Nayantara!
episodesList.summary: Jealous Brinda ousts Nayantara from her bedroom after discovering her helping Dev. Was it a deliberate provocation?

episodesList.title: Shalakha Honey-traps Dev!
episodesList.summary: To win Dev, Shalakha tricks him into a honeymoon. Can Brinda stop her?

episodesList.title: Vishaka's Identity Gets Exposed!
episodesList.summary: Vishaka's revenge: Shalaka's plot against Brinda exposes her. Will truth conquer hatred?

episodesList.title: Brinda's Naagin Avatar Exposed!
episodesList.summary: Naagin Brinda's victory turns sour. Shalakha's revelation traps her. Will Brinda overcome this?

episodesList.title: Can Brinda Convince Dev?
episodesList.summary: Dev leaves family drama. Brinda's secret may make him stay.

episodesList.title: Shalakha Manipulates Dev!
episodesList.summary: Shalakha's obsession with Dev blinds her to Brinda's love. Using a stolen fragment of Dev's soul, she manipulates him to break up with Brinda. Will Brinda fight back?

episodesList.title: Brinda's Mother is Murdered!
episodesList.summary: A mother's death. A lover's deception. Brinda confronts a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Brinda Swears to Avenge!
episodesList.summary: Dev killed Brinda's mother and plans to leave her for Shalaka. Fueled by rage, Brinda vows revenge.  Her plan unfolds now.

episodesList.title: Can Dev Protect His Family?
episodesList.summary: A Naagin's wrath descends on a wedding. Dev defends his family against Brinda's deadly quest for revenge.

episodesList.title: Naagin Legacy Unleashed
episodesList.summary: In the sacred year of the 2025 Mahakumbh, danger strikes India. Chosen as the protector, Naagin Anantha's fate will decide everything.

episodesList.title: Naagin Rescues Purvi and Anantha
episodesList.summary: Goons attack Purvi and Anantha, prompting the Naagin to protect them. Later, as the moonlight falls on Purvi, she begins to transform into the Naagin, in pain.

episodesList.title: Parmeet's Shield Against The Naagin
episodesList.summary: Purvi feels intense itching as her skin peels off during her serpent transformation. Later, Parmeet shows his friends the dragon, claiming it will protect them from the Naagin.

episodesList.title: Naagin's Deadly Battle
episodesList.summary: Purvi secretly saves a young boy using her snake powers. Later, she transforms into a Naagin as the snakes come to her aid, leading the battle against the wolf.

episodesList.title: Ravish Confesses The Truth
episodesList.summary: Samir catches Ravish with his wife and threatens Prameet. Later, Ravish admits he loves Anantha, wants to marry her, and claims the baby she carries is his.

episodesList.title: Gurinder Hunts Parmeet's Secret
episodesList.summary: Parmeet plots to expose the Maha Naag Rani, while Karan's prank tricks Purvi into confessing her love. Later, Gurinder shocks everyone by accusing Parmeet's family of being spies.

episodesList.title: Parmeet's Family Takes a Dark Turn
episodesList.summary: Parmeet accuses Anantha of being the Naagin and demands the Naag Mani. Later, his family brutally kills Gurinder's family, as Anantha reveals to Purvi that she is the true Naagin.

episodesList.title: Purvi Awakens As Naagin
episodesList.summary: Purvi rises from the mud as the Naagin and attacks the men who buried her alive. Later, Airul gives ten days to find the Naagmani, triggering a deadly hunt.

episodesList.title: Purvi Disguises As Ahana
episodesList.summary: An upset Vikram refuses the engagement with Pinky, leading to a confrontation with Aryaman. Later, Purvi disguises herself as Ahana and enters Parmeet's house as Vikram's lover.

episodesList.title: Naagin's Revenge Claims Swarna
episodesList.summary: Purvi and Vikram's engagement ceremony begins as they exchange rings. Later, Purvi transforms into the Naagin, stabs and kills Swarna, framing Samir for the crime.

episodesList.title: Samir Faces Naagin's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Under a dinner pretext, Aryaman spikes Purvi's drink to uncover her truth. Later, the Naagin attacks Samir as he is released from jail and prepares to return to his country.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Bold Defiance
episodesList.summary: Ahana confesses her supernatural identity after Aryaman exposes the video evidence. Later, she refuses to let him ruin the wedding and vows to fight back.

episodesList.title: Vikram Fumes At Aryaman
episodesList.summary: As part of the wedding rituals, Ahana and Aryaman walk seven rounds around the yagna and tie the sacred thread. Later, Vikram confronts Aryaman for marrying Ahana in his stead.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Love Becomes Her Weakness
episodesList.summary: As Ahana turns Naagin to protect the diamond, Aryaman witnesses her truth. Torn by love, she spares him and chooses a perilous path to erase his memories forever.

episodesList.title: Bharani's Plot Against Love Fails
episodesList.summary: Bharani fumes, recalling how she posed herself as Aryaman and attacked, yet failed to stop the Naagin from loving him. Later, Ahana wipes Aryaman's memory before he can expose her.

episodesList.title: Ahana Perceives Mahadev's Divine
episodesList.summary: After the Puja, Ahana performs the Shiv Tandav, believing Mahadev is guiding her to the Divya Naagin. Later, Vikram entrusts his company shares to Purav and Radhika.

episodesList.title: Bharani Faces Ahana's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Ahana lashes out at Bharani, accusing her of killing Anantha while disguised as Aryaman. Later, Ahana reminisces about Aryaman and shares her grief with Anantha.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Deadly Revenge
episodesList.summary: At a party, Aryaman and Vikram's clash turns explosive until Ahana intervenes. Later, she transforms into a Naagin and eliminates Pammi in a shocking act of revenge.

episodesList.title: Aryaman's Battle to Save India
episodesList.summary: Ahana grows cautious after finding the Mantra book as Chengistan plots against India. Later, Aryaman warns everyone about the threat and decides to inform the militant force.

episodesList.title: Can Ahana Save the Amarnath Yatris?
episodesList.summary: Amid rising danger, Ahana tries to solve the mystery of her new attacker. After overhearing about the threat to the Amarnath Yatra train, Ahana rushes to their rescue.

episodesList.title: Aryaman's Secret Past Unveiled
episodesList.summary: Ahana discovers Aryaman’s shocking past and makes a heartbreaking choice. Later, she and Bharani infiltrate a high-security centre to uncover the enemy's plan.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Deadly Discovery
episodesList.summary: Ahana discovers Aryaman's family's killers, who plan to destroy India. Later, she cleverly infiltrates Erul's base amidst creature attacks, escaping only to uncover a new enemy.

episodesList.title: The Dragon Targets Radhika!
episodesList.summary: Ahana discovers Radhika's secret and her lingering love for Aryaman. Tension heightens when Radhika gets attacked by a mysterious dragon. Who'll step in to save her?

episodesList.title: Aryaman Loves Ahana
episodesList.summary: Ahana secretly saves Tina from Dimple’s murder attempt and prepares to take revenge on the family. Later, Aryaman rejects Radhika, as he realises his love for Ahana.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Revenge Strikes Dimple
episodesList.summary: Ahana forces a terrified Dimple to do the same manual labour she once mocked. Using her Naagin powers, Ahana crushes her under stones, taking revenge.

episodesList.title: The Dragon Pearl's Secret Power
episodesList.summary: After snatching the Dragon Pearl during the battle to save the Ramos launch, Ahana realises it can remove the dragon’s illusion and reveal its true human identity.

episodesList.title: Ahana Unmasks Pinky's Fiancé
episodesList.summary: Ahana discovers that Pinky’s new fiancé is actually a dangerous dragon in disguise. She tries to warn the family, but they don't believe her and celebrate the engagement instead.

episodesList.title: Yaman's Arrival Flips the Script
episodesList.summary: Yaman's arrival stuns Ahana as events unfold unexpectedly. With the wedding just two days away, Ahana realises her plan has spiralled out of control.

episodesList.title: Bharni Falls to Ravish’s Wrath
episodesList.summary: A drugged Ahana misleads her enemies while hunting for secret papers. Meanwhile, a betrayal leaves Bharni unconscious and at the mercy of the vengeful Ravish.

episodesList.title: Ahana’s Spooky Scheme
episodesList.summary: At Mangalpur’s eerie Bhoot Bangla, Ahana plots a supernatural haunting to stall Pinky’s wedding. Parmeet falls prey to ghostly pranks, leaving the family in terror.

episodesList.title: Ahana Faces Dragon King
episodesList.summary: Guruji alerts Ahana about Dragon King Bahumath, while Yaman offers Ahana a deal to get back his dragon pearl and leave Pinky's life.

episodesList.title: Radhika's Ultimate Darkness Emerges
episodesList.summary: Pinky's wedding turns tragic when Yaman is found dead, raising Ahana's suspicions. Radhika awakens as the ultimate dragon, hinting at an epic Naagin–Dragon battle ahead.

episodesList.title: Radhika Plots Against Ahana
episodesList.summary: As power and betrayal collide, Radhika secretly weaves a dangerous plan to bring Ahana down. While Ahana senses something amiss, hidden motives and dark forces begin to surface.

episodesList.title: The Dragon Conspiracy Unfolds
episodesList.summary: Ahana fights off goons to save Tina, foiling Parmeet's plan. A shocking twist unfolds as Radhika reveals how Basha and the scientists tested on her to awaken the ultimate dragon.

episodesList.title: Aryaman Hands Divorce Papers
episodesList.summary: A tiger sent by Radhika confronts Ahana, who transforms into a naagin, sparking a fierce battle. Soon after, Ahana is heartbroken as Aryaman hands her their signed divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Ahana's Revenge Awakens
episodesList.summary: Shattered by Aryaman's betrayal, Ahana's pain turns into fierce rage as she embraces her Naagin powers. As Radhika tightens her grip and dark forces rise, Ahana vows revenge.

episodesList.title: Erul Halts the Weddings
episodesList.summary: As Ahana prepares to marry Vikram and Radhika weds Aryaman, the wedding turns dramatic when Erul storms in. Chaos erupts as hidden motives surface and loyalties are tested.

episodesList.title: Radhika’s Deadly Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Ahana reclaims her identity as the Anant-kul Naagrani and the Nagmani. However, her in-laws frame her for murder while the secretive Radhika begins targeting her.

title: Nanda Saukhya Bhare
summary: Nanda Saukhya Bhare is an Indian Marathi language TV series that aired on Zee Marathi. The show premiered on 20 July 2015, replacing Ase He Kanyadan, and ended its run on 1 October 2018. It was produced by Aadesh Bandekar under the banner of Soham Productions. It starred Rutuja Bagwe, Chinmay Udgirkar and Suhas Paranjape in lead roles.

summary: Narayan Narayan — Chulbule Narad Ki Natkhat Leelaye is a mythological comedy television series that aired on BIG Magic, an Indian television station. It is centered on the humorous pursuits of the sage Narada.
plot: The central theme of the show is the intermingling of established mythological characters with contemporary comedy. With the sage Narad and Lord Vishnu as the central characters, the plot revolves around their mentor-devotee relationship with light-hearted humor, mythological devotion as well as moral teachings that are summarized at the end of every episode. The Hindu Trinity (Trimurti) consisting of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva along with their consorts (Goddesses Lakshmi, Saraswati and Parvati), is represented here in addition to a host of other mythological characters, primarily classified as Devas, like Indra, Agni Dev, Narad is portrayed as the prime devotee of Lord Vishnu, and his mischievous exploits across the celestial and earthly realms, along with his best friend Chingu, are showcased here.

title: Neeli Chatri Waale
summary: Neeli Chatri Waale is an Indian television program produced by Ashwni Dhir and broadcast on Zee TV. The show is based on a Tamil story Kadavulum Kandhasami Pillaiyum by Pudhumaipithan.
plot: The series based on Kanpur follows a common man named Bhagwan Das who is torn between his personal and professional life. He is bullied by his boss, wife, and father, and his children are ashamed of his profession as an underwear salesman. Bhagwan Das meets Shivaye, a human representation of the Hindu god Shiva. Shivaye, whom only Bhagwan Das can see, guides Bhagwan Das through various dilemmas.

title: Nisha Aur Uske Cousins
summary: Nisha Aur Uske Cousins (Nisha and Her Cousins) is an Indian Hindi-language coming of age romantic drama television series which aired on StarPlus from 18 August 2014 to 27 June 2015. It starred Aneri Vajani and Mishkat Varma. The story revolved around the relationship between seven cousins residing in the Jaipur city of Rajasthan and focused on the family disputes caused by the difference of opinions due to generation gaps.
plot:
Set against the backdrop of Jaipur, it showcases the unconventional bond among seven cousins - Umesh, the oldest amongst the cousins whose passion is cooking; Dolly, a soon-to-be-married shopaholic and her fiancé Sumit; Kirti, a slightly narcissistic, self-involved fashionista; Nisha, a tomboy and a daredevil at heart; Suketu, an aspiring actor; Jwala, smart, painfully shy loveable geek; and Bunty, the youngest among all the cousins, and a typical mischief-maker, living in a joint family consisting of three brothers, their wives, Grandpa and Grandma.
Grandpa is a strict man who loves his grandchildren but believes in discipline and traditions. His ideals and mindset differ from the cousins' and the concept "Friends are forever, Cousins are for life!".
Despite their differing personalities, the cousins are linked together by a common thread of love and friendship and are each other's support system. Saurav, their childhood friend, is also a part of the cousins' gang.
The cousins sort through all the troubles that crop up during Dolly's wedding (that they themselves inevitably caused) and ensure she marries Sumit.
Umesh wants to open his own restaurant but is scared of his father who wants him to continue their family business. Suketu's dream of becoming an actor is not supported by Dadaji and he too is made to join the family business. Kirti breaks her relationship with her fiancé, Ritesh, after learning of his selfish motives. Jwala's tuition teacher tries to misbehave with her but she's saved by Nisha, which leads to the revelation that Nisha was a victim of child abuse when she was thirteen, after which she became a tomboy.
Nisha becomes inspired by Viraj Singh Rathore, a national level shooter and joins his Lakshya Academy as an office assistant. She writes mails to him in the name of Aarti to help him come out of his loneliness. Meanwhile, Umesh's girlfriend's - Amanpreet's father passes away, motivating Umesh to take a stand against his family and announce that he wants to marry Amanpreet, which is not received well by the elders who want Umesh to marry a Jain. Viraj and Amanpreet develop a brother-sister bond. After a few incidents, Umesh and Amanpreet marry with the family's consent.
The whole truth of Nisha being Aarti is presented in a bad way in front of media at a press conference by Viraj's bua Gayatri, abusing Viraj and Nisha's relationship. Viraj is left shattered.
After facing harsh words from Viraj, a heart-broken Nisha decides to go on a trip alone to discover herself where she meets Kabir (an artist who earns money from photography) who has come to Jaipur from Dubai in search of his brother, whom he has never met. While trying to save a little girl Chandu and themselves from the goons, both end up getting married accidentally and again marry unwillingly in front of Nisha's family due to Grandpa's insistence. They mutually agree on a contract marriage of three months after which Kabir would go to London, to fulfill his dream of becoming a world renowned dancer. Ramesh decides to follow his passion and opts out of the family business and starts his own music class.
Sumit gets jealous of the growing fondness of the family for Kabir and plots against him along with his mom and Rupan and traps him in a fake jewellery case. But while Nisha along with her cousins plans to clear Kabir's name while Nisha meets with an accident because of Sumit and is hospitalised and Kabir is imprisoned. After regaining conscious Nisha and her cousins along with Ramesh and Lakshmi proves Kabir's innocence and convict Sumit for his crimes. Kabir and Nisha realise they are in love with each other but do not confess. Meanwhile, Kaira reveals Gayatri's truth and Viraj realises his mistake of not trusting Nisha and also that he loves her and tries to get her back in his life.
Kabir's mom Vasundhara comes down to India and reprimands her son for lying to her about him being in London and hiding about his marriage. Though she accepts the marriage initially, she vows to separate them as she learns that Nisha is a Gangwal as she hates the Gangwals due to some past issues. It is then shown that Viraj and Kabir are brothers and Vasundhara had to leave Viraj when he was a child due to circumstances. She uses Viraj to create misunderstandings between Nisha and Kabir without knowing that Viraj is her son. Kabir thinks that Nisha is still in love with Viraj and decides to leave to London. Vasundhara gets to know that Viraj is her son, realises her mistake and asks Nisha to reunite the brothers. Viraj and Kabir reunite. Viraj realises that Nisha loves Kabir and decides to move on. Vasundhara apologizes to everyone and decides to be with Viraj. In the meantime, Dolly gets to know that she's pregnant but decides to raise her baby alone and applies for divorce from Sumit.
The story ends with Saurav and Dolly's love confession, Kabir proposing Nisha and their happy reunion with the cousins and the whole Gangwal family rejoicing and a flashback of all their happy moments is shown with the cousins theme song, Firdausiyana plays in the background.
reception:
Nisha Aur Uske Cousins initially received praise from critics and audiences alike for its fresh concept and youth-focused narrative and as a result saw high ratings.
As a part of the promotion, Star Plus introduced a free mobile app on 24 July which is World Cousins Day.

articleSections.text: Because of his character's transition from good to bad, Taher Shabbir quit the show in June 2015 as he didn't like how his character was shaping up.

episodesList.title: Dolly's Pre-Wedding Party
episodesList.summary: The countdown to Dolly's wedding has begun and Nisha decides to host a special party on the occasion. The cousins have a blast. Problems crop up when it comes to paying the caterer. What happened to the money Nisha gave Suketu for the purpose?

episodesList.title: Nisha And Her Cousins Are Caught
episodesList.summary: As they have no money to pay the caterer Nisha hands over the keys of her scooter as payment. Just then their Dadaji arrives on the scene.  The ladies in the house are busy preparing breakfast. Everyone makes it to the dining table, except Nisha and her father. How will they  manage the situation?

episodesList.title: Dadaji Confronts Nisha
episodesList.summary: Lakshmi wins the breakfast competition and is gifted with a pair of bangles by Nisha's grandmother.  Nisha and her cousins are reprimanded by Dadaji who throws a new challenge to them.

episodesList.title: Jatin Follows Kriti
episodesList.summary: Nisha and her cousins are busy finding new ways to get the money back. Jatin misbehaves with Kriti. Nisha and her cousin retaliate. The police arrives on the scene. Where will this lead to?

episodesList.title: The Wedding Celebrations Begin
episodesList.summary: Dadaji is upset with Nisha and her cousins, and calls his sons to discuss the issue. Will the cousins face more problems? Dolly's wedding celebrations are on in full-swing during which Virender scolds Ramesh.

episodesList.title: Will Nisha Wear A Lehenga?
episodesList.summary: Nisha tries to gain Dadaji's attention and gets hurt in the process. Her family tries to convince her to wear a lehenga for the wedding. Will Nisha pay heed to their desires?

episodesList.title: Ramesh And Lakshmi Argue
episodesList.summary: Kirti floors everyone with her dance, while Jwala and Nisha struggle to match up to her steps. Lakshmi and Ramesh get upset with each other and have an argument. Nisha calms them down.

episodesList.title: Nisha And Jwala Play A Prank
episodesList.summary: Umesh makes Dolly emotional by creating a recipe book for her. Later, Dolly visits a beauty parlour. Jwala and Nisha decide to play a prank on her. What will this act cost them?

episodesList.title: Umesh Wears A Lehenga
episodesList.summary: There's a lot of action between the cousins as Nisha refuses to wear a lehenga. They try to convince Umesh to wear one and take Nisha's place in the dance. Will Nisha wear a lehenga?

episodesList.title: Virender Is Angry With Umesh
episodesList.summary: Virender is furious on learning that Umesh has a girlfriend. However, Nisha is happy to inform her cousins about it. Suketu and Kirti argue with Umesh.

episodesList.title: Dolly And Sumit Dance Together
episodesList.summary: The atmosphere gets romantic as Dolly and Sumit dance together. Dadi reminisces about her love story, which she shares with her grandchildren. Lakshmi appears visibly tense. Why is she worried?

episodesList.title: Search For Umesh's Bride Begins
episodesList.summary: The elders decide it is time for Umesh to get married and Virender starts looking out for a bride. But, Umesh is very upset with the news and he tells Nisha about it. What will happen when their Dadaji comes to know about it?

episodesList.title: Will Nisha Find Her Match?
episodesList.summary: Now that Umesh's love life is known to everyone, grandmother decides she must focus on getting Nisha married. The search begins. Will Nisha find her match?

episodesList.title: Nisha Goes On A Date Ritesh
episodesList.summary: The cousins act as matchmakers between Nisha and Ritesh and make them spend some time together. Everyone feels he is the best match for her. But what's in Nisha's mind?

episodesList.title: Umesh And Kirti Get Locked Out
episodesList.summary: His financial condition continues to worry Ramesh but Lakshmi reassures him. The cousins keep playing cupid between Ritesh and Nisha, and go to his room. But, Leela locks them up.

episodesList.title: Plan To Kidnap Ritesh
episodesList.summary: Kirti and Umesh force Nisha to kidnap Ritesh, but instead they end up kidnapping someone else. What will happen when that person's family comes looking for him?

episodesList.title: Dolly, Sumit Spend Time Together
episodesList.summary: Dolly and Sumit plan on spending some time together. Nisha and her cousins try to warn her about Dadaji and Leela who are going up to the terrace looking for Ravi. Leela sees someone go out of the Gangwal House. Will the lovebirds be caught?

episodesList.title: Ramesh Gets Angry With Nisha
episodesList.summary: Nisha is caught in the crossfire when Dadaji asks her to tell the truth. Virender criticises her. The cousins are surprised when even her father scolds her.

episodesList.title: Vimala Thanks Nisha
episodesList.summary: Dadaji asks Nisha to tell him about her boyfriend. Nisha maintains her stance and her cousins support her. Vimala tells Nisha she knows the truth about who escaped from the house the previous day and thanks her.

episodesList.title: Nisha Searches For A Boyfriend
episodesList.summary: Nisha persuades Saurav to pretend to be her boyfriend. Kirti also asks Ritesh to help arrange a fake boyfriend for Nisha.  Suketu is shocked to see that his bike has been damaged.

episodesList.title: Dolly Is Upset With Sumit
episodesList.summary: Pre-wedding rituals are on in the house. Dolly is upset to know that Sumit will not move to Bangalore. It is time for the elders to gift the shagun to Dolly. Rupan and Vimala give their share, it now Lakshmi's turn. Saurav goes to meet Nisha's Dadaji and is in for a surprise.

episodesList.title: The Missing Money Envelope
episodesList.summary: A problem arises when Leela finds only two envelopes. She realises that Ramesh's envelope is missing and Virender gets upset with him. Nisha is furious when she comes to know what Suketu did with the shagun money. Will she tell everyone?

episodesList.title: Suketu Realises His Dolly
episodesList.summary: Dadaji is upset with Ramesh for giving Suketu money for the bike. Suketu realises his mistake and apologises to his parents. But Nisha is still unable to make it up to her Dadaji. Will he forgive her?

episodesList.title: Dadaji Talks To Saurav
episodesList.summary: Dadaji calls Saurav over to his shop to speak and he assumes it is about the CCTV camera. Meanwhile, someone has sent a mail to Sumit's boss requesting for a transfer. Will Sumit find out who is behind this and will that affect his relationship with Dolly?

episodesList.title: Sumit Gets Drunk
episodesList.summary: There are problems when Jwala keeps non-vegetarian food in the dining hall along with the vegetarian fare. Suketu informs Nisha that Sumit is intoxicated. She decides to follow him. How will she salvage the situation?

episodesList.title: Will Dadaji Find Out?
episodesList.summary: Jwala and Bunty believe they have got rid of the non-vegetarian dishes before Dadaji can find out. Meanwhile, the cousins are stressed as Sumit hasn’t come back as yet. Will Nisha manage to bring him back in time?

episodesList.title: Dadaji Is Furious
episodesList.summary: Saurav, Ritesh and Nisha make Sumit dance in the baraat. Bunty helps Sumit by giving him his skates. Later, Dadaji is furious to know that non-vegetarian food was brought to the dining hall and orders for its disposal.

episodesList.title: Leela Is Upset With Dadaji
episodesList.summary: The issue over non-vegetarian food at the wedding continues. Leela gets very upset and decides to leave the venue. Will that affect the wedding or will Nisha and her cousins manage to convince Leela?

episodesList.title: Dadaji Scolds Umesh
episodesList.summary: Dadaji reprimands Umesh about the non-vegetarian food. He also gets to know that Sumit was drunk during the wedding. Everyone is emotional as Dolly leaves for her in-laws' house.

episodesList.title: The Cousins Get Emotional
episodesList.summary: The cousins are very emotional during Dolly's departure. Dadaji decides to go against traditions and let the girls lift the palanquin as well. Later, Nisha and her cousins continue to miss Dolly. Will Saurav manage to cheer them up?

episodesList.title: Dadaji Plans For Nisha’S Marriage
episodesList.summary: Dadaji is upset with Nisha and Suketu for their behaviour in Dolly’s wedding. He decides to get Nisha married to Ritesh. He asks Suketu to work in his jewellery shop and asks him to take an ice bucket challenge.

episodesList.title: Ritesh Is Interested In Nisha
episodesList.summary: Dadaji plans to fix Nisha's marriage with Ritesh. Dolly tells her cousins about Ritesh’s interest in Nisha. But does anyone know what Nisha’s choice is?

episodesList.title: Ritesh Comes For Dinner
episodesList.summary: Ritesh is invited by Dadaji to the Gangwal house for dinner. Grandmother asks Lakshmi to cook for everyone. There is panic when Nisha's parents realise she is not at home.

episodesList.title: Nisha Gets Home Late
episodesList.summary: Ritesh arrives for dinner and Dadaji is infuriated at not finding Nisha at home. The family tries to keep him engaged. Is Nisha coming home late on purpose?

episodesList.title: Nisha Doesn’T Want To Marry
episodesList.summary: Nisha expresses her lack of interest in marriage, but Dadaji doesn’t pay heed to her opinion and fixes her marriage. This upset her parents and cousins. Is Ritesh indeed the right match for Nisha?

episodesList.title: Ritesh Tries To Impress Nisha
episodesList.summary: Ritesh vows to impress Nisha but she seems unmoved. Will Nisha's parents manage to convince Dadaji to change his decision?

episodesList.title: Suketu's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Ritesh uploads a picture with Nisha and updates his relationship status on a social networking site. This creates a new round of confusion in the house.

episodesList.title: Nisha Buys A Birthday Cake
episodesList.summary: Ritesh sees Umesh and Amanpreet in a restaurant. Meanwhile, Nisha buys a birthday cake for Suketu and the Gangwal family makes arrangements for his birthday party.

episodesList.title: Suketu Ignores His Family
episodesList.summary: Ritesh brings cake and gifts an expensive watch to Suketu on his birthday. An excited Suketu ignores his family. Suketu’s family is upset with him as he cuts Ritesh’s cake. Later, Nish and her cousins have a cake fight.

episodesList.title: Ritesh Misbehaves With Nisha
episodesList.summary: Nisha overhears Ritesh's conversation with Sumit. He tries to misbehave with her and Nisha retaliates. How will Nisha get back at Ritesh?

episodesList.title: Nisha Takes Revenge On Ritesh
episodesList.summary: Nisha makes a plan to teach Ritesh a lesson and mixes pills in his coffee. Ritesh starts to behave weirdly as a result. Meanwhile, Vimala suggests that Lakshmi should send Nisha for counselling. Nisha catches Umesh with his girlfriend.

episodesList.title: Vimala Confronts Umesh
episodesList.summary: Ritesh tells Vimala about Umesh's girlfriend and she confronts him about it. Meanwhile, Bunty brings Dadaji to the terrace on Nisha's insistence. What's her and Saurav's plan?

episodesList.title: Suketu Beats Up Ritesh
episodesList.summary: Nisha informs Dadaji about Ritesh's behaviour the previous night. He warns Ritesh to know his limits. The cousins get upset on knowing the truth and get into a scuffle with Ritesh.

episodesList.title: Nisha Tries To Set Things Right
episodesList.summary: Ritesh’s parents plan to visit the Gangwal house. Suketu and Nisha apologise to him. Nisha tries to set things right in the house and clear the air with Kirti.

episodesList.title: Suketu Goes To Udaipur
episodesList.summary: Dadaji and Ramesh have an argument over sending Suketu to Udaipur. Meanwhile, Virender is in a panic mode as he has lost a necklace from the consignment.

episodesList.title: Vimala Follows Nisha
episodesList.summary: Dadaji blames Ramesh for the missing necklace and orders him not to visit the shop.  Nisha tries to bring Vimala and Lakshmi together. Later, Nisha goes in search of Umesh, unaware that Vimala is following her.

episodesList.title: Dadi Has A Panic Attack
episodesList.summary: Ramesh ends up fighting with his brother, which upsets grandmother. She tries to reason with her son, but no one seems ready to listen. At night, Dadi has a panic attack.

episodesList.title: A Surprise For Dadi
episodesList.summary: Umesh apologises to Nisha and they make up. Ritesh eavesdrops on their conversation. Nisha and her cousins plan a surprise for their grandmother.

episodesList.title: Nisha And Her Cousins Gift A Smart Phone To Dadi
episodesList.summary: Virender, Mohan and Ramesh have their morning tea with Dadi. Ritesh brings a doctor to the Gangwal house for Dadi's check-up. Dadaji informs Dadi that Ritesh's parents will be visiting the Gangwal house, to finalise his marriage with Nisha. Rupan appoints an expensive tutor for Jwala. Nisha and her cousins gift a smart phone to Dadi.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Opposes Nisha’S Marriage
episodesList.summary: Dadaji stops Ramesh from coming to the jewellery shop. Ramesh opposes his decision of getting Nisha married. Nisha is happy to overhear their conversation. Meanwhile, Laxmi consults a counsellor for Nisha.

episodesList.title: Nisha Agrees To Marry Ritesh
episodesList.summary: Ramesh learns that Ritesh and Kirti like each other. Meanwhile, Ritesh visits Gangwal House with his parents. Nisha agrees to marry him. But her decision upsets Dadi and Ramesh. Nisha has her reasons.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Informs Nisha About Kirti
episodesList.summary: Ritesh’s parents want him to get engaged to Nisha, before they return to US. Jwala is worried about Nisha. Ramesh tells Nisha that Kirti likes Ritesh. Meanwhile, Suketu learns about Nisha’s marriage.

episodesList.title: Laxmi Learns About Nisha’S Past
episodesList.summary: Laxmi asks Nisha if she has ever been abused, but Nisha ignores her. Laxmi tries to find out about her past by visiting her school and finds Nisha’s diary. Meanwhile, Jwala fares badly in mathematics, hides the same from Rupan.

episodesList.title: Ashish Pretends To Help Jwala
episodesList.summary: Laxmi suspects Nisha to have been abused in a sports meet held at Pilani in 2006. Dolly informs her the principal of her school, Mrs Singh knows about the incident. Laxmi persuades Mrs Singh to talk about it. Meanwhile, Ashish pretends to help Jwala for the re-examination.

episodesList.title: Ashish Misbehaves With Jwala
episodesList.summary: Ashish tries to misbehave with Jwala. Nisha rescues her. She later confides in Laxmi about how a few boys had misbehaved with her in the past. Rupan finds out about the Jwala incident.

episodesList.title: Nisha Brings Police
episodesList.summary: The family learns about Ashish’s misbehaviour with Jwala. Nisha brings the police to the Gangwal House. However Mohan informs the police that he does not want to lodge a complaint against Ashish.

episodesList.title: Dadaji Wants Justice For Jwala
episodesList.summary: The Gangwal family discusses Ashish’s misbehaviour. Nisha and her parents want justice for Jwala. Umesh, Suketu, Kirti and Jwala want it too. Dadaji then decides to bring Ashish to justice.

episodesList.title: Nisha's Reasons
episodesList.summary: Nisha asks Laxmi to keep her secret from Ramesh. Suketu informs Laxmi about Nisha agreeing to marry Ritesh, so Dadaji allows Ramesh to work in his jewellery shop. Laxmi decides to reveal Nisha’s secret to Dadi.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Ramesh learns that Nisha agreed to marry Ritesh for his sake. Meanwhile, Laxmi tells Dadi about Nisha’s secret. Dadi then advises her to share the same with Ramesh. Meanwhile, Dolly tries to convince Nisha against marrying Ritesh.

episodesList.title: Laxmi Is In A Dilemma
episodesList.summary: It's Diwali. Nisha and her cousins ask the family men to cook while the women decorate the house. Ramesh realises Kirti and Ritesh love each other. Laxmi is confused whether to reveal Nisha's secret to Ramesh.

episodesList.title: Dadaji Learns A Secret
episodesList.summary: Dadaji eavesdrops on Laxmi and Dadi’s conversation. Meanwhile, Ramesh puts up a skit to make his family realise about Ritesh-Kirti's love for each other.

episodesList.title: Dadaji Learns About Nisha
episodesList.summary: Laxmi informs Dadaji about Nisha’s secret. She requests him to call off her engagement. Meanwhile, Ritesh realises, Nisha and he are incompatible and that he makes a good pair with Kirti.

episodesList.title: Dadaji Questions Nisha
episodesList.summary: Dadaji questions Nisha on keeping the family in dark about her secret. Nisha’s cousins don’t want her to marry Ritesh. Mohan and Ramesh decide to inform Dadaji about Kirti and Ritesh. Later, Ritesh’s family visits the Gangwal House.

episodesList.title: Kirti And Ritesh Are Engaged
episodesList.summary: Ritesh gets engaged to Kirti with Dadaji’s blessings. Umesh asks Ritesh to take good care of Kirti. Later, Sumit decides to go on a picnic with Dolly and her cousins.

episodesList.title: Laxmi Hides Nisha's Secret From Suketu
episodesList.summary: Nisha informs Dadaji that she will be honoured by Virat Singh Rathore, and requests him to permit Sumit, Dolly, Kirti and Ritesh to accompany her to the palace. He agrees but advises them to behave responsibly. Would Umesh and Amanpreet expose their relationship if they accompany the group?

episodesList.title: Nisha Receives The Appreciation Letter
episodesList.summary: Umesh introduces Amanpreet to his cousins and they all have a good time at the palace. Nisha receives the appreciation letter, but she accidentally leaves it in the palace. Will Nisha meet Virat Singh Rathore? Will she be able to retrieve her appreciation letter?

episodesList.title: Nisha Meets Virat Singh Rathore
episodesList.summary: Nisha is impressed when she witnesses Virat Singh Rathore practising rifle shooting. When she panics seeing a dog, Virat Singh Rathore advises her to overcome her fears. She then falls down, injuring herself and Virat carries her as she’s unable to walk. Is there something kicking off between the two?

episodesList.title: Ramesh Learns About Nisha's Secret
episodesList.summary: Ramesh gets upset when he discovers Nisha's secret but Dadaji comforts him. Nisha's cousins make fun of her, but she is lost in her own thoughts. Dadaji and Ramesh are extremely happy to see Nisha's appreciation letter. Will Nisha and Virat Singh Rathore meet again?

episodesList.title: Nisha Decides To Work
episodesList.summary: Amanpreet’s father is looking to get her married within their community and Umesh convinces him to consider him. Nisha is determined to get a job and Saurav stands by her decision. Everyone except Virender encourages Nisha and requests Dadaji to give her permission. Will the Gangwal family agree?

episodesList.title: Mohan Gifts A Set Of Bangles To Rupan
episodesList.summary: Nisha informs her family that she is inspired with a rifle shooter, Viraj Singh Rathod, and wants to join his Lakshya academy. She decides to attend an interview in Lakshya academy. Suketu and Kirti wish Nisha for the same. Mohan gifts a set of bangles to Rupan. Saurabh informs Nisha about Viraj's arrival in the academy. Viraj's aunt becomes enraged at Nisha as she makes fun of her. Rupan becomes frightened on learning that the bangles are missing and informs Laxmi about the same. Will Nisha get selected in Lakshya academy?

episodesList.title: Rupan Accuses Rukma To Have Stolen Her Bangles
episodesList.summary: Rupan accuses Rukma of stealing her bangles. Viraj takes control of the academy from his aunt who misleads Nisha about the vacancy available. Nisha gets furious but Viraj's aunt humiliates her and orders her to leave the academy. Will Nisha accept defeat by Viraj’s aunt?

episodesList.title: Nisha Applies For A Job
episodesList.summary: Saurabh asks Nisha not to disturb Viraj Singh Rathod during his practice. Nisha requests Saurabh to help her secure a job at Lakshya academy. On seeing Nisha's application, Viraj Singh Rathod asks his sister to call Nisha for an interview. Will Nisha be able to nail the interview?

episodesList.title: Nisha Accepts Gayatri's Challenge
episodesList.summary: Nisha assures Rukma that she will search for Rupan's bangles. Later, Gayatri challenges Nisha to get Viraj Singh Rathod's signature on a form in order to attend the interview. Nisha accepts Gayatri's challenge. Will Nisha be able to get Viraj Singh Rathod's signature?

episodesList.title: Umesh Confesses To Robbery
episodesList.summary: Nisha witnesses an accident while chasing Viraj Singh Rathod's car for his signature. A dejected Umesh informs Ramesh and Laxmi that he loves Amanpreet and that he stole the bangles to prevent Mr. Singh from getting Amanpreet married. How will Ramesh and Laxmi handle the situation?

episodesList.title: Viraj Confronts Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod learns that Priyanka is the member of a nightclub. An infuriated Viraj Singh Rathod rebukes Gayatri for hiding from him that Priyanka is alcoholic. A dejected Umesh apologises to Mr Singh for his mistake. Will Nisha be able to get Viraj Singh Rathod's signature?

episodesList.title: Gayatri Vows To Stop Nisha
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod asks Nisha to attend the interview, but Gayatri is determined to stop Nisha. Umesh reveals to the family that he stole the bangles. An infuriated Vimla slaps Umesh and refuses to accept his relationship with Amanpreet.

episodesList.title: Viraj Is Furious At Nisha
episodesList.summary: Nisha and her cousins decide to accompany Umesh to Amanpreet's house. The next day, Nisha decides to visit the academy early in the morning. Viraj Singh Rathod is furious when he finds Nisha sleeping in his chair. Will Viraj Singh Rathod forgive Nisha?

episodesList.title: Nisha’S Interview At Lakshya
