episodesList.summary: Nisha apologises to Viraj Singh Rathod for her mistake and informs him about Mr. Singh's death in an accident. Meanwhile, a dejected Umesh delivers the miserable news to Dadi. Nisha attends an interview at Lakshya academy. Will Nisha be able to impress Viraj in the interview?

episodesList.title: Nisha Gets Locked In A Room
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Gayatri rebukes Priyanka for consuming alcohol and a heated argument ensues between the two. Saurabh asks Nisha to get Viraj Singh Rathod's signature on her employment form. Sham Singh accidentally locks Nisha in Viraj's house. How will Viraj react when he finds Nisha in his house?

episodesList.title: Nisha Tries To Hide
episodesList.summary: Virendra informs Vimla that they have to visit Leela's house. Meanwhile, Nisha tries to hide in Viraj Singh Rathod's house. Gayatri informs Viraj Singh Rathod that Mr. Bajaj wants to establish a seven star hotel and wants the academy's land. Will Viraj agree to sell the land?

episodesList.title: Viraj Confronts Nisha
episodesList.summary: Vimla agrees to accompany Virendra to Dolly's house. Meanwhile, an infuriated Viraj Singh Rathod confronts Nisha for entering his house without his permission. Nisha apologises to Viraj Singh Rathod for her mistake and requests him to sign the employment form. Will Viraj Singh Rathod oblige?

episodesList.title: Nisha’S Application Gets Rejected
episodesList.summary: Nisha apologises to Laxmi for returning home late. She informs Ramesh that she is not going to the office as Viraj Singh Rathod rejected her application. Ramesh and Laxmi encourage Nisha to give Lakshya academy another try. Will Viraj Singh Rathod allow Nisha into Lakshya Academy?

episodesList.title: Priyanka Lies To Viraj
episodesList.summary: A delighted Nisha informs Laxmi that she got the job in Lakshya academy. A dejected Dolly asks Sumit about Leela's attitude towards Virendra and Vimla. Priyanka lies to Viraj Singh Rathod that she sprained her leg in order to skip shooting practice. Will Viraj Singh Rathod buy Priyanka’s story?

episodesList.title: Dolly Confronts Leela
episodesList.summary: Dadi and Rupan congratulate Nisha for her job at Lakshya academy. Virendra and Vimla visit Sumit's house to meet Dolly. Nisha shares her experience about her first day in the office with Jwala. A dejected Dolly confronts Leela for insulting her. Will Dolly forgive Leela?

episodesList.title: Kirti Congratulates Nisha
episodesList.summary: Nisha, Suketu and Umesh bring Amanpreet to the Gangwal house. Kirti informs Ritesh about the party at the Gangwal house. Mohan witnesses Kirti embracing Ritesh. Kirti congratulates Nisha about her job. Will the Gangwal family be able to celebrate in peace?

episodesList.title: Family Celebrates Nisha's Success
episodesList.summary: Laxmi and Umesh inform Dadi about Amanpreet's ill health. The Gangwal family celebrates Nisha's success. Amanpreet's uncle informs Ramesh that Umesh has brought Amanpreet to the Gangwal house. The family members hide Amanpreet from Dadaji. Will Dadaji learn about Amanpreet?

episodesList.title: Vimla Sees Amanpreet In The House
episodesList.summary: Dadaji warns the Gangwal family that they should not invite Amanpreet to their house without his permission. Gayatri apologises to Viraj Singh Rathod for her mistake. Vimla sees Amanpreet in the house. Dadi tries to prove Umesh's innocence to Vimla. Will Viraj Singh Rathod forgive Gayatri?

episodesList.title: Umesh Shares His Miseries
episodesList.summary: Umesh shares his miseries with Nisha. Ramesh tells Gayatri that Nisha is his daughter. Nisha informs Viraj Singh Rathod that Priyanka, Ekta and Anjali have reached for practice. Will Nisha be able to fulfill her responsibilities?

episodesList.title: Viraj Singh Rathod Rescues Umesh
episodesList.summary: Nisha apologises to Viraj Singh Rathod. Viraj Singh Rathod asks his employee to cancel his meeting. He asks Priyanka, Ekta and Anjali to start the shooting practice. Nisha is shattered when Umesh is assaulted. Viraj Singh Rathod rescues Umesh from goons. Will Priyanka realise her mistake?

episodesList.title: Priyanka And Gayatri Join Hands
episodesList.summary: Dadaji informs Ramesh that he will not allow Umesh to marry Amanpreet. Meanwhile, Priyanka and Gayatri plot to extract money from Viraj Singh Rathod and Nisha overhears their conversation. Will Nisha reveal Priyanka and Gayatri's plan to Viraj Singh Rathod?

episodesList.title: Vimla Warns Umesh
episodesList.summary: Priyanka refuses to attend shooting practice and Nisha informs Viraj Singh Rathod about it. Meanwhile, an infuriated Vimla warns Umesh that their relationship will end if he marries Amanpreet. Will Vimla be able to stop Umesh from marrying Amanpreet?

episodesList.title: Viraj Confronts Priyanka
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Viraj Singh Rathod confronts Priyanka for her misbehaviour towards Nisha. Meanwhile, a dejected Vimla informs Ramesh about Umesh’s decision regarding his court marriage.

episodesList.title: Nisha Tries To Motivate Virendra
episodesList.summary: Rukma informs Nisha about Virendra's ill health, and Nisha tries to motivate Virendra. Later, Nisha confronts Priyanka for her misbehaviour. Viraj Singh Rathod is surprised to see Amanpreet in his office. Ramesh asks Umesh to talk to Virendra about marrying Amanpreet. Will Umesh be able to do so?

episodesList.title: Virendra Suffers A Heart Attack
episodesList.summary: Umesh gets frightened when Virendra loses consciousness. Ramesh and Umesh get Virendra admitted to a hospital. Later, Laxmi informs Nisha that Virendra suffered a heart attack and is hospitalised. Amanpreet asks Umesh to withdraw their marriage application from the court. Will Virendra recover?

episodesList.title: Nisha Thanks Viraj For His Help
episodesList.summary: A dejected Umesh informs Nisha about his wedding date. Meanwhile, Nisha thanks Viraj Singh Rathod for his help. Shekhar assures Viraj Singh Rathod that he will convince the investors to invest in Lakshya academy. Later, Priyanka, Ekta and Anjali make fun of Nisha. Will Nisha forgive them?

episodesList.title: Laxmi Suspects Nisha’S Feelings
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod cheers up an upset Nisha. Meanwhile, Dadi is taken aback when she sees Amanpreet in the Gangwal house. Later, Laxmi suspects that Nisha likes Viraj Singh Rathod. Ramesh and Laxmi try to zero in on what’s upsetting Nisha. What is troubling Nisha?

episodesList.title: Nisha's Plan For Amanpreet
episodesList.summary: Nisha and her cousins convince Dadi to allow Amanpreet to associate with the Gangawal family as a cook. Amanpreet and Umesh make a deal to stop seeing each other if Amanpreet fails to impress the Gangwal family. Will Amanpreet be able to impress the Gangwals?

episodesList.title: Nisha Shows Priyanka Her Place
episodesList.summary: Nisha and Saurav are upset on seeing their obscene pictures. Priyanka gets pummelled by Nisha and confesses to her misdeeds. Viraj Singh Rathore rebukes Priyanka and instructs her to report to Nisha henceforth. Will Priyanka learn her lesson?

episodesList.title: Priyanka Apologises To Nisha
episodesList.summary: Priyanka apologises to Nisha at Viraj Singh Rathore's insistence. He suggests they control their emotions. Meanwhile, Priyanka’s mother is unhappy with Viraj's decision. Later, Nisha meets Shekhar on Viraj’s suggestion. Will the meeting be fruitful?

episodesList.title: Vimla's Wedding Anniversary
episodesList.summary: Ramesh asks Amanpreet to bake a cake for Vimla and Virender's wedding anniversary. Later, Laxmi tells Vimla that Dolly baked the cake. Ritesh takes an intoxicated Kirti to his house. Will Vimla learn the cake was baked by Amanpreet?

episodesList.title: Vimla Confronts Ramesh And Laxmi
episodesList.summary: Kirti falls asleep in Ritesh's house. Vimla confronts Ramesh and Laxmi for lying to her about the cake. Nisha sends an anonymous mail to Viraj Singh Rathore. She falls asleep while waiting for Viraj Singh Rathore's reply. Will Viraj Singh Rathore respond to Nisha's mail?

episodesList.title: Viraj Singh Rathod’S Meeting
episodesList.summary: Ritesh's mother informs Ritesh about her plan against Kirti. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod informs Nisha about his meeting. Later, Shekhar asks Nisha to meet him after working hours. Will Ritesh's mother succeed in her plan against Kirti?

episodesList.title: Shekhar Tries To Console Nisha
episodesList.summary: Ritesh and his mother Sunita visit the Gangwal house. Meanwhile, Nisha decides to hide the mail from Viraj Singh Rathod. She shares her miseries with Shekhar, who tries to console and motivate her. Will Viraj learn about Nishas mail?

episodesList.title: Ritesh Gifts Earrings To Kirti
episodesList.summary: Ritesh gifts earrings to Kirti and informs her about the loss in their business. Later, Ritesh and Sunita discuss their plan of acquiring Kirti's property. Meanwhile, Shekhar steals a file from Viraj Singh Rathod's drawer. Will Shekhar succeed in his misdeed against Viraj?

episodesList.title: Nisha Retrieves The Bag
episodesList.summary: Nisha witnesses a man replacing Viraj Singh Rathod's bag and follows him. She succeeds in retrieving the bag. Meanwhile, Shekhar enquires with his associate about the bag. Later, Nisha informs Viraj about the incident. Will Viraj discover Shekhar’s misdeed against him?

episodesList.title: Viraj Singh Rathod Rescues Nisha
episodesList.summary: Rupan informs Umesh, Suketu and Dolly about Kirti's proposed marriage. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod comes to Nisha’s rescue as she slips of a cliff and gets injured. Later, Laxmi tells Dolly that Nisha likes Viraj. Will Nisha be able to accept her feelings for Viraj?

episodesList.title: Nisha Shares Her Miseries
episodesList.summary: Nisha’s cousins decide to make Nisha confess to her love for Viraj Singh Rathod. Meanwhile, Nisha shares her miseries with Viraj. Later, Viraj's driver reports to Shekhar that Nisha has injured herself. What diabolical ploy is Shekhar hatching against Viraj?

episodesList.title: Shekhar Vows To Ruin Viraj's Life
episodesList.summary: Laxmi informs Viraj Singh Rathod about Nisha's birthday. Later, Shekhar and his associate attack Viraj to pilfer his bag, but Nisha shoots Shekhar who then vows to ruin Viraj's life. Will Viraj present a special gift to Nisha on her birthday?

episodesList.title: Nisha's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod informs Ramesh and Laxmi of Nisha rescuing him from the goons. Later, the Gangwal family celebrates Nisha's birthday. Nisha's cousins and Sourabh discuss their plan to make Nisha confess her love for Viraj. Will Nisha's cousins succeed in their endeavour?

episodesList.title: Nisha's Cousins Have A Plan
episodesList.summary: Sourabh informs Nisha about her cousins’ plan of making her confess her love to Viraj Singh Rathod. Nisha confronts Suketu for sending a message from her mobile to Viraj inviting him to her birthday party. Will he attend it?

episodesList.title: Nisha Loves Viraj
episodesList.summary: Umesh invites Viraj Singh Rathod to Nisha's birthday party. Later, Umesh apologises to Ramesh for his mistake and tells him that he has invited Viraj to Nisha's party. Later, Nisha expresses her feelings for Viraj to her cousins. Will Nisha share them with Viraj as well?

episodesList.title: Nisha’S Birthday Celebration
episodesList.summary: Amanpreet informs Nisha that Viraj Singh Rathod has come to attend her birthday party. Later, Viraj Singh Rathod informs Dadaji and the Gangwal family that he wants to train Nisha as a shooter. Will Dadaji and Virendra learn about Umesh's relationship with Amanpreet?

episodesList.title: Viraj Dances With Nisha
episodesList.summary: Amanpreet informs Nisha that Viraj Singh Rathod has come to attend her birthday party. Later, Viraj Singh Rathod informs Dadaji and the Gangwal family that he wants to train Nisha as a shooter. Will Dadaji and Virendra learn about Umesh's relationship with Amanpreet?

episodesList.title: Laxmi Tries To Calm Ramesh
episodesList.summary: Laxmi tries to calm Ramesh upon seeing him worried about Nisha. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod asks Nisha to convince Dadaji about her shooting practice. Later, a frightened Amanpreet informs Kirti that Ritesh and his family are deceiving the Gangwal family. Will Nisha succeed in her endeavour?

episodesList.title: Kirti Slaps Ritesh
episodesList.summary: Shekhar plans to throw Nisha out of Lakshya academy. Meanwhile, Ritesh and Sunita confess their crime in front of the Gangwal family. An infuriated Kirti slaps Ritesh, following which he reveals Amanpreet's identity to them. Will Shekhar succeed with his plan?

episodesList.title: Dadaji Confronts Mohan
episodesList.summary: Amanpreet reveals Ritesh's misdeed against Kirti to Dadi. Dadaji overhears their conversation and confronts Mohan for concealing the truth from him. Nisha asks Rupan to keep Amanpreet's identity hidden from Dadaji. Rupan apologises to Dadaji for her mistake. Will Rupan pay heed to Nisha?

episodesList.title: Mohan Scolds Rupan
episodesList.summary: Dadaji refuses to permit Nisha to go for shooting practice but Nisha's cousins assure her that they will convince him. Later, Mohan scolds Rupan and asks her to keep Amanpreet’s identity concealed from Dadaji. Will Nisha’s cousins be able to keep their word?

episodesList.title: Dadaji Watches Nisha Perform
episodesList.summary: A dejected Laxmi requests Vimla to allow Amanpreet to stay in the Gangwal house till Virendra recovers. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod requests Dadaji to decide if Nisha will be allowed to train after watching her perform. Will Dadaji be convinced after witnessing Nisha’s skills?

episodesList.title: Rupan Confronts Amanpreet
episodesList.summary: Dadaji permits Nisha to train for shooting. An infuriated Rupan confronts Amanpreet for insulting her. Meanwhile, Gayatri and Shekhar discuss their plan to close the Lakshya Academy. Later, Shekhar removes the spring from Nisha’s gun.

episodesList.title: Jwala, Dolly Save Amanpreet
episodesList.summary: Laxmi accidentally puts a romantic card in Nisha's file. Rupan conspires against Amanpreet, but the plan is foiled when Jwala and Dolly intervene. Sourabh takes the file to Gayatri's cabin, but she doesn't see the card. Will she eventually spot it? Will Viraj learn about Nisha's feelings?

episodesList.title: Rupan Apologises For Her Misdeeds
episodesList.summary: Rupan apologises to Amanpreet. Nisha daydreams about professing her love to Viraj Singh Rathod. Nisha is embarassed when Viraj Singh Rathod reads the card. Gayatri mocks Nisha. What is Viraj Singh Rathod's reaction and how Will Nisha perform in the competition?

episodesList.title: Nisha Disappoints Viraj
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod convinces the investors to believe in the shooters of his academy. Later, Viraj has his hopes pinned on Nisha but she puts up a dismal performance and the investors refuse to back Lakshya Academy.

episodesList.title: Nisha Is Sad About Her Poor Show
episodesList.summary: Nisha feels dejected about letting Viraj Singh Rathod down. Leela taunts Vimla for accepting Amanpreet into their family. Laxmi and Ramesh try to cheer Nisha up. Nisha realises that Shekhar has stolen the investor's file. She tries to inform Viraj Singh Rathod, but is unable to.

episodesList.title: Nisha Consoles Viraj
episodesList.summary: A crestfallen Viraj Singh Rathod is consoled by Nisha. Later, Nisha discovers Shekhar’s evil intentions. Rupan bribes Amanpreet's uncle for taking her back with him. Meanwhile, Nisha texts Viraj Singh Rathod as Aarti and tries to comfort him. Will Viraj Singh Rathod discover the truth?

episodesList.title: Viraj Finds Out Shekhar’S Ploy
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod discovers that Nisha's rifle was defective. Nisha confronts Shekhar and Viraj overhears their conversation. Later, Shekhar vows revenge as the police arrest him. Does Viraj have a soft spot for Nisha?

episodesList.title: Viraj Thanks Nisha For Her Help
episodesList.summary: Nisha discloses Gayatri's true intentions to Viraj Singh Rathod. Gayatri tries to defend herself, but to no avail. Later, Viraj Singh Rathod expresses his gratitude to Nisha with a card.

episodesList.title: Viraj Breaks Nisha's Heart
episodesList.summary: Nisha misunderstands that Viraj has gifted her the card and the dress. Later however, Viraj clarifies saying he does not love her. A crestfallen Nisha returns home and is comforted by Ramesh.

episodesList.title: Viraj Shuts Down Lakshya Academy
episodesList.summary: Amanpreet helps Veerendra in surviving a heart attack. Viraj declares to the employees of Lakshya Academy that he is shutting it down. Later, he tries to talk to Nisha but Ramesh takes her away.

episodesList.title: Viraj Decides To Move To London
episodesList.summary: Nisha resolves to get out of Viraj Singh Rathod's life, both as Arti and Nisha. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod decides to leave for London. Later, Amanpreet's uncle tries to abduct her while she's talking to Viraj Singh Rathod on the phone. Will Viraj Singh Rathod be able to save her?

episodesList.title: Nisha-Viraj Look For Amanpreet
episodesList.summary: Umesh informs Virendra that Punam is actually his girlfriend Amanpreet. On everyone's insistence, Virendra agrees to accept her as his daughter-in-law. Meanwhile, Nisha and Viraj Singh Rathod reach the Gharana guest house to look for Amanpreet.

episodesList.title: Viraj And Nisha Rescue Amanpreet
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod and Nisha rescue Amanpreet from her uncle and his associates. Later, the family members are delighted as Dadaji agrees to let Umesh and Amanpreet get married. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod decides to leave for London.

episodesList.title: Nisha Stops Viraj From Going
episodesList.summary: Nisha learns that Viraj is leaving for London and decides to stop him. Meanwhile, Dadi tries to make Rupan and Vimla realise their mistake. Later, Nisha takes away Viraj's passport and assures him of finding investors for Lakshya Academy.

episodesList.title: Nisha Has An Idea
episodesList.summary: Ramesh informs Nisha about the 'Rajasthan Youth Talent Icon' competition and asks her to participate in it. Nisha decides to help the Lakshya Academy by winning the competition and convinces her cousins to represent the academy in the competition.

episodesList.title: Nisha Is Late For The Audition
episodesList.summary: Saurav and Suketu manage to get Viraj Singh Rathod's signature on the recommendation letter. However, Nisha and her cousins reach the audition late and the manager refuses to let them in. Later, Nisha thinks of a way to convince him.

episodesList.title: Priyanka Challenges Nisha
episodesList.summary: Nisha argues with Viraj Singh Rathod for registering in the talent show. Nisha and her cousins are shocked to learn that Priyanka is a member of the reigning champion team. Priyanka challenges Nisha. Nisha and her cousins are called inside for the audition.

episodesList.title: Team Lakshya Clears The Audition
episodesList.summary: Team Lakshya clears the audition with the help of Viraj Singh Rathod. Gayatri tries to instigate Viraj against Nisha. Viraj reveals to Arti about his broken engagement with Kayra. Nisha decides to tell him Arti's truth.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Confronts Nisha
episodesList.summary: Dadaji asks Nisha and her cousins to rehearse their dance performance for Umesh and Amanpreet's wedding. On Nisha's insistence Viraj Singh Rathod agrees to dance with her. Later, Ramesh confronts Nisha for sending e-mails to Viraj in the name of Arti. Will Nisha be able to placate Ramesh?

episodesList.title: Kirti Gets Locked In
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Nisha confronts Priyanka for misbehaving with a contestant. Later, Nisha tries to motivate Kirti for a solo dance performance. However, Gayatri’s associate locks Kirti in the restroom to prevent her from performing in the second round.

episodesList.title: Nisha Goes Solo!
episodesList.summary: Nisha's cousins are delighted as she agrees to perform solo. The judges agree to give more time to Suketu and Saurabh to prepare. Meanwhile, Dadi asks Vimla to give her mother's sari to Amanpreet. Later, Nisha presents her solo dance performance.

episodesList.title: Team Lakshya Reaches The Final
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod praises Nisha for her performance. Kirti informs Nisha and Suketu about the woman who locked her in the restroom. Team Lakshya qualifies for the final. Gayatri informs Priyanka that Viraj loves Arti. Will Viraj be able to find out about Arti's identity?

episodesList.title: Ramesh Makes Fun Of Virendra
episodesList.summary: Jwala informs Nisha that Viraj Singh Rathod is in love with Arti. Later, Nisha reveals to her cousins that she sent those mails in Arti’s name. Nisha decides to reveal her identity to Viraj. Meanwhile, Ramesh makes fun of Virendra.

episodesList.title: Umesh Gets Married To Amanpreet
episodesList.summary: Dadaji allows Viraj Singh Rathod to dance at Umesh's wedding. Later, Nisha decides to reveal Arti's identity to Viraj. The Gangwals celebrate Umesh's marriage to Amanpreet.

episodesList.title: Suketu Makes Plan To Stop Nisha
episodesList.summary: Ramesh and Suketu try to stop Nisha from revealing Arti's identity to Viraj Singh Rathod but to no avail. Suketu makes a plan with his cousins to stop Nisha. Ramesh overhears Gayatri and Priyanka making fun of Nisha's talent.

episodesList.title: Nisha Decides To Bide Her Time
episodesList.summary: Ramesh confronts Gayatri. Nisha decides to wait till the finale to reveal about Arti to Viraj Singh Rathod. Viraj finds the card he had given to Arti. Leela comes to take Dolly back with her.

episodesList.title: Team Lakshya Wins!
episodesList.summary: Gayatri finds out that Nisha is Arti. Team Lakshya performs at the finale and is declared the winner. Viraj Singh Rathod yearns to meet Arti. Gayatri decides to reveal Arti's identity to Viraj. Will Nisha be able to inform Viraj about Arti in time?

episodesList.title: Gayatri Calls A Press Meet
episodesList.summary: Nisha and Viraj thank each other for their victory. The cousins ask Nisha to wait till the next day to reveal about Arti to Viraj. The Gangwals celebrate Team Lakshya's win. Gayatri calls a press conference the next day.

episodesList.title: Umesh's First Night Is Ruined
episodesList.summary: Suketu, Bunty and Jwala tease Umesh about his first night with Amanpreet. The cousins make fun of Viraj's emails to Arti. Lakshmi shares her concern for Nisha with Ramesh. Nisha frets about her confrontation with Viraj and the press meet.

episodesList.title: Arti's Truth Is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Virendra asks Umesh to go on honeymoon with Amanpreet. Viraj and Nisha are dumbfounded when the reporters ask Viraj about Arti. They inform Viraj that Saurabh has circulated his mails to Arti on the internet and Nisha had sent those mails! Will Nisha accept that she is Arti?

episodesList.title: Nisha Gets Ready To Meet Viraj
episodesList.summary: Dadaji slaps Viraj for humiliating Nisha in front of the media. Ramesh tries to assure Dadaji of Nisha's intentions, which were not wrong. Dolly is shocked to see Nisha getting ready to go out on a date with Viraj. Will Viraj accept Nisha's apology?

episodesList.title: Viraj Misunderstands Nisha
episodesList.summary: Viraj feels heart-broken. Nisha waits for him at the restaurant. She misconstrues another guy to be Viraj and professes her love to him. Viraj overhears her and reproaches Nisha's misdeeds. Nisha tries to explain her intentions to him, but in vain. Will Nisha fight for her integrity?

episodesList.title: Kabir Motivates Nisha
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Nisha confronts Viraj for his behaviour. Kabir introduces himself to Nisha and tries to motivate her. Meanwhile, Laxmi is worried about Nisha and asks Ramesh about her. Amanpreet advises Bunty to support Nisha. Dadaji tries to make Nisha realise her mistake.

episodesList.title: Viraj Is Leaving For London
episodesList.summary: Amanpreet confronts Umesh for his behaviour towards Viraj Singh Rathod. She suggests to Nisha's cousins that they must clear the misunderstanding between Nisha and Viraj. Viraj informs Gayatri that he is leaving for London. He thanks Mr. Singh for helping the Lakshya Academy.

episodesList.title: Nisha Wants To Go On A Trip
episodesList.summary: Virendra informs Guruji that they are searching for a groom for Nisha. Nisha tells her cousins that she wants to go on a trip. Later, Nisha agrees to accompany Umesh and Amanpreet to a resort. Dadi asks Umesh and Amanpreet to cancel their Mount Abu trip.

episodesList.title: Kabir Meets Nisha
episodesList.summary: Dadi discovers Nisha's plan and becomes worried. Veerendra finds out about Nisha's trip to Mt. Abu. Ramesh decides to hide the truth about Umesh cancelling his trip. He decides to stop Nisha from visiting the resort. Nisha becomes emotional when Umesh tells her the truth. Kabir meets Nisha.

episodesList.title: Dadi Confronts Ramesh
episodesList.summary: Virendra confronts Ramesh for allowing Nisha to go alone on a trip. Meanwhile, a thief steals Kabir's bag. Dadaji decides to bring Nisha back to the house. Dadi confronts Ramesh for misbehaving with Dadaji. Kabir follows the thief but fails to catch him. Nisha and Kabir have an argument.

episodesList.title: Kabir And Nisha Rescue A Child
episodesList.summary: Dadaji asks Virendra, Mohan and Ramesh to manage the business. Ramesh tells Virendra that he will not be coming to their shop, henceforth. Meanwhile, Kabir and Nisha rescue a child, Chandra from goons. Rupan informs Laxmi that Ramesh allowed Nisha to go on the trip, despite Dadaji's refusal.

episodesList.title: Nisha Books A Room For Chandra
episodesList.summary: Ramesh informs Virendra that he has given the responsibilities of the shop to Suketu. Virendra confronts Ramesh for his decision. Meanwhile, on Kabir's request, Nisha books a room for Chandra at the Blue Roof resort. Shanti Devi and her associate search for Chandra.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Leaves The Gangwal House
episodesList.summary: Nisha mistakes Kabir to be a goon and hits him on the head. Meanwhile, a dejected Ramesh leaves the Gangwal House. Nisha confronts Kabir for trying to sneak into the room like a thief. An infuriated Viraj Singh Rathod asks Gayatri to leave his house. Will the Gangwals be able to find Ramesh?

episodesList.title: Kabir Hides Chandra In A Dustbin
episodesList.summary: A conductor informs Shantidevi that he has seen Chandra. Meanwhile, Dadi asks Umesh to not inform Nisha about Ramesh's misunderstanding with Dadaji. Later, Laxmi is shattered learning that Ramesh has left the house. Kabir hides Chandra in a dustbin.

episodesList.title: Shantidevi Finds Chandra
episodesList.summary: Kabir succeeds in rescuing Chandra from Shantidevi and her goons. An advocate informs Gayatri that her share in the property is 20 per cent. Viraj informs Gayatri that he is planning to donate his property to charity. Later, Kabir and Nisha are shattered seeing Chandra with Shantidevi.

episodesList.title: Kabir-Nisha In Disguise
episodesList.summary: Kabir tries to calm Nisha. Chandra's uncle informs Kabir and Nisha that Shantidevi threatened to kill him. He asks Kabir and Nisha to rescue Chandra. Kabir and Nisha disguise as villagers to rescue Chandra. Later, Chandra's uncle gets injured as Shantidevi shoots him.

episodesList.title: Kabir Apologises To Nisha
episodesList.summary: Kabir challenges Nisha to rescue Chandra. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod sees Kaira worried. Kaira realises her mistake and thanks Viraj for his help. Kabir apologises to Nisha for his mistake. Kabir and Nisha discuss their plan of rescuing Chandra.

episodesList.title: Kabir And Nisha Rescue Chandra
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Nisha reach the guesthouse to rescue Chandra. Shantidevi and her associates follow Kabir and Nisha as they see Chandra escaping with them. Later, Kabir, Nisha and Chandra enter a 'Samuhik Vivah' pandal to hide from Shantidevi and her associates.

episodesList.title: Kabir, Nisha And Chandra Escape!
episodesList.summary: Shantidevi and her associates search for Kabir, Nisha and Chandra in the pandal. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod apologises to Kaira and insists that she stay in his house. Gayatri informs Kaira about her plan of acquiring Viraj's property. Kabir, Nisha and Chandra escape from the pandal.

episodesList.title: Nisha Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Chandra's mother is delighted upon seeing her. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod is surprised as Kaira organises a candlelight dinner for him. Gayatri is shattered learning Viraj has a younger brother. Bunty reveals to Nisha that Ramesh has left the house.

episodesList.title: Shantidevi Abducts Kabir
episodesList.summary: Bunty reveals to Nisha that Ramesh has left the house. Nisha decides to search for Ramesh. Kabir informs Nisha about Ramesh. Shantidevi and her associates attack Kabir and abduct him. Nisha tells Kirti about Kabir. Will Nisha be able to learn about Kabir's abduction?

episodesList.title: Kabir Is Abducted!
episodesList.summary: Nisha tries to make Dadaji realise his mistake and requests him to resume working in the shop. Meanwhile, Shantidevi enquires with Kabir about Chandra and Nisha's whereabouts. Gayatri enquires with Sham about Viraj's mother, Vasundhara. Nisha is shattered learning about Kabir's abduction.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Nisha informs Amanpreet and Dolly that she had to get married to Kabir to rescue Chandra from Shantidevi. She is surprised seeing Kabir alive. Later, Ramesh returns to the house. Kabir informs the Gangwals that the police have arrested Shantidevi and her associates.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Apologises To Laxmi
episodesList.summary: Dadaji insists that Kabir stay at the Gangwal House. Amanpreet informs Kirti and Jwala about Nisha's marriage with Kabir. Meanwhile, Gayatri suggests Viraj Singh Rathod to get married but he refuses. Ramesh apologises to Laxmi for his mistake. Will Viraj be able to learn about Gayatri's evil plan?

episodesList.title: Viraj Is In Love With Nisha
episodesList.summary: Mr Goel invites Dadaji for the Holi celebration. Meanwhile, a furious Viraj Singh Rathod refuses to attend the celebration. The Gangwals are surprised as Sumit comes to the house. Kaira professes her love to Viraj but he tells her that he is in love with Nisha!

episodesList.title: Mr Goel Apologises To Dadaji
episodesList.summary: Nisha tells Kirti that she has asked Rukma to mix thandai in Kabir's glass of milk. Kabir insists Rukma to drink the milk. Nisha witnesses Viraj Singh Rathod with Kaira. Mr Goel apologises to Dadaji for his mistake. Will Nisha learn about Viraj's friendship with Kaira?

episodesList.title: The Gangwals Celebrate Holi
episodesList.summary: Kaira informs Gayatri that Nisha and her family have come for the Holi celebration. Dadaji allows Nisha and her cousins to participate in the celebration. Meanwhile, Dadi, Vimla and Laxmi insist that Dadaji celebrate Holi with the family. Virendra and Mohan try to convince Ramesh to celebrate Holi with the family.

episodesList.title: Gayatri's Plan Against Viraj
episodesList.summary: Nisha tells Kabir that she hates Viraj Singh Rathod. Gayatri asks Kaira to keep Viraj away from Nisha. Sumit informs Dolly that Dadaji has had thandai. Later, Ramesh unintentionally throws colour on Dadaji. Kabir dances with Nisha and her cousins in the Holi celebration.

episodesList.title: Kabir-Viraj At Loggerheads
episodesList.summary: The Gangwals are delighted to see Dadaji and Ramesh playing Holi together. Ramesh apologises to Dadaji on Nisha's behalf. Kabir apologises to Kaira for his mistake. Nisha confronts Kabir and Viraj Singh Rathod for attacking each other. Kaira blames Nisha for Viraj's behaviour.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Wants To Teach Music
episodesList.summary: Kirti informs Dolly and Amanpreet about Viraj Singh Rathod's fight with Kabir. Ramesh informs Dadaji about his aspiration to become a music teacher. Nisha tells Dadaji that she will work in their shop instead of Ramesh's. Viraj sees Gayatri giving money to Kaira.

episodesList.title: Kabir-Nisha's Wedding Goes Public
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod asks Gayatri the reason she gave money to Kaira. Meanwhile, Dolly is shattered as Sumit has lost his job. Dadi tries to motivate Ramesh. Kabir is shocked seeing his and Nisha's wedding photographs in a magazine.

episodesList.title: Sumit's Plan Against The Gangwals
episodesList.summary: Gayatri asks Kaira to convince Viraj Singh Rathod to marry her. Meanwhile, Kabir is delighted as Ramesh gives Unmukt Sabu's address to him. Virendra praises Nisha for convincing a customer to buy a pair of earrings. Sumit informs Leela about his plan of acquiring the Gangwal shop.

episodesList.title: Nisha's Marriage Revealed?
episodesList.summary: Kabir enquires with Unmukt, a photographer. Gayatri informs Nisha about Viraj Singh Rathod's proposed marriage with Kaira. A pandit informs Dadaji about seeing Nisha's marriage photograph in a magazine and shows it to him!

episodesList.title: Nisha Agrees To Marry Kabir
episodesList.summary: Kabir reveals to Dadaji about his marriage with Nisha being fake. Later, Dadaji decides to get Nisha married to Kabir again. Kabir is shocked as Nisha agrees. Suketu tells Amanpreet about Viraj Singh Rathod's proposed marriage with Kaira.

episodesList.title: Kabir Escapes
episodesList.summary: Suketu informs Amanpreet about Viraj Singh Rathod's proposed marriage with Kaira. Nisha's cousins try to make her realise her mistake. Later, Nisha apologises to Kabir. Unmukt informs Gayatri about someone asking him about the photograph. Nisha helps Kabir to escape from the Gangwal House.

episodesList.title: Kabir Returns To Gangwal House
episodesList.summary: Nisha is shattered seeing Kabir and confronts him for returning to the Gangwal House. Later, Suketu informs Ramesh about Nisha agreeing to marry Kabir under compulsion. Nisha tells Dadi about the same. Ramesh confronts Nisha for agreeing to marry Kabir.

episodesList.title: Viraj Confronts Nisha
episodesList.summary: The Gangwals make fun of Kabir. Kabir informs Dadaji about his family background. Later, Kabir pays a stranger to pretend as his relative and attend his marriage. Kirti informs Kaira about Nisha's proposed marriage with Kabir. Nisha professes her love to Viraj, who confronts her for lying to him.

episodesList.title: Nisha-Kabir's Sangeet!
episodesList.summary: Ramesh requests Dadaji to allow him to fulfill the responsibilities of a father. He tells Laxmi that he will sell the gold coins for Nisha's marriage. Nisha tries to calm Laxmi. Saurabh introduces himself to Kabir. Later, the Gangwals celebrate Nisha's sangeet and mehendi ceremonies.

episodesList.title: Kaira Reveals Gayatri's Misdeed
episodesList.summary: The Gangwals dance in the sangeet ceremony. Meanwhile, Viraj Singh Rathod offers thirty percent of his property to Kaira. He confronts Gayatri after Kaira reveals her misdeed to him and casts Gayatri out of the house.

episodesList.title: Nisha Refuses To Marry Viraj
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod apologises to Nisha for his mistake and professes his love to her. A furious Nisha confronts Viraj for misbehaving with her family and refuses to marry him. Later, Kabir and Ramesh ask Viraj to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Nisha-Kabir Get Married!
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Nisha inform Dadaji about their wish to skip the kanyadaan ritual. Later, Ramesh and Dadaji tell Nisha the importance of kanyadaan. Ramesh performs Nisha's kanyadaan. The Gangwals rejoice as Nisha marries Kabir.

episodesList.title: Unmukt Hides Viraj's Identity
episodesList.summary: Kabir informs Virendra that he will not accept money from the Gangwals. Kabir and Nisha discuss their contract marriage. Later, Ramesh thanks Kabir for his support. Unmukt conceals Viraj's identity from Kabir. The Gangwals are grief-stricken as they prepare for Nisha's bidaai!

episodesList.title: Nisha's Bidaai And A Twist!
episodesList.summary: The Gangwals are dejected seeing the recording of their moments spent with Nisha. Ramesh's students dedicate a song to Nisha. Kabir promises Ramesh of taking good care of Nisha. The Gangwals are grief-stricken as Nisha leaves with Kabir. Will Kabir be able to learn about 's true identity?

episodesList.title: Viraj On A Mission
episodesList.summary: Kabir informs Nisha that her cousins have escaped with his bag. Dadaji and Ramesh remember Nisha fondly. Dadi tries to pacify Ramesh. Viraj Singh Rathod is determined to find out the actual reason behind Nisha and Kabir's marriage.

episodesList.title: Kabir Is Viraj's Brother!
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Nisha draw up rules about their contractual marriage. Unmukt informs Gayatri that Kabir is Viraj Singh Rathod's younger brother. Shamsingh eavesdrops on Gayatri's conversation with Unmukt and decides to inform Viraj Singh Rathod.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Tries To Kill Shamsingh
episodesList.summary: Shamsingh meets with an accident as Gayatri pushes him in front of the car. Later, the police take Gayatri into custody after Shamsingh testifies against her. Meanwhile, Laxmi performs Nisha's pagphere ritual. A nurse informs Viraj about Shamsingh's condition!

episodesList.title: Kabir To Work For The Gangwals
episodesList.summary: Dadaji asks Kabir to work for the ad campaign of the Gangwal Jewellers. He tells Nisha that he will allow her to work at their shop, if she succeeds in making food. Later, Kabir informs Nisha that he has been shortlisted for the London Dance Academy.

episodesList.title: Viraj Is Nisha's Landlord
episodesList.summary: Rupan argues with Mohan as Dadaji has allowed Kabir to work for Gangwal Jewellers. Meanwhile, Kabir performs Nisha's grihapravesh. Nisha is shattered learning that Viraj is the landlord of her house. Later, Kabir and Nisha start with the food preparation.

episodesList.title: Nisha's Sweet Dish Fails To Win
episodesList.summary: The Gangwals visit Nisha's new house. Meanwhile, Umesh informs Kabir that the sweet dish prepared by Nisha is not good. Later, Nisha is dejected as the family refuses to eat the sweet dish prepared by her. Saurabh informs Viraj the reason behind Nisha and Kabir's marriage.

episodesList.title: Viraj Learns Nisha's Shaadi Truth
episodesList.summary: Saurabh tells Viraj the reason behind Nisha and Kabir's marriage. Meanwhile, Kabir's plan of ruining his own image before the Gangwals fail as Dadaji appreciates his outlook towards the family. Dolly informs Ramesh and Laxmi that Sumit has lost his job.

episodesList.title: Viraj Apologises To Nisha
episodesList.summary: Kabir apologises to Nisha for signing the rent agreement without reading it. He informs Nisha that his interview has been preponed. Meanwhile, Sumit is livid with Dolly for revealing to Ramesh about him losing his job. Viraj Singh Rathod apologises to Nisha for his mistake.

episodesList.title: Kabir Clears The Interview
episodesList.summary: Kabir sprains his leg as he slips while rehearsing. Nisha takes Kabir to the venue of the interview. Meanwhile, Sumit informs Rupan about his misunderstanding with Dolly. He tries to provoke Rupan against Kabir. Nisha is happy as Kabir clears the interview.

episodesList.title: Shamsingh Regains Consciousness
episodesList.summary: Saurabh informs Nisha about Shamsingh regaining consciousness. Dolly informs Kabir that Sumit has lost his job and thanks him for his help. Meanwhile, the doctor informs Viraj about Shamsingh's condition. Kabir tells Nisha about Unmukt trying to hide something from him.

episodesList.title: Kabir Assaults Rohan
episodesList.summary: A furious Kabir assaults Unmukt's son, Rohan, for his misbehaviour. Meanwhile, a nurse informs Nisha about Shamsingh's health being critical. Ramesh assures Kabir of helping him find his brother. Nisha informs Saurabh about her contract marriage with Kabir!

episodesList.title: Shamsingh Passes Away!
episodesList.summary: Bunty informs Kabir that he has failed in his exams. Later, Sumit apologises to Dadaji for hiding the truth. Dadaji asks Sumit to work as Kabir's assistant. A furious Laxmi slaps Bunty for tampering with his mark sheet. Meanwhile, Nisha gets upset when Viraj tells her about Shamsingh's death.

episodesList.title: Viraj Knows Nisha's Marriage Truth
episodesList.summary: Viraj Singh Rathod tells Nisha that he is aware of her and Kabir's contract marriage. Nisha informs Kabir about Shamsingh's death. Laxmi is dejected learning that Bunty is missing from the house. Vimla tries to console Laxmi. Rupan informs the family about Kabir misleading Bunty to tamper with his mark sheet.

episodesList.title: Kabir Rescues Bunty
episodesList.summary: Virendra tries to calm Ramesh. The Gangwals search for Bunty, who is hiding on the terrace. Kabir suffers an electric shock while rescuing Bunty and loses his consciousness.  Later, Bunty apologises to Kabir for his mistake. He informs Dadaji about Kabir's brave act.

episodesList.title: Rupan Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Dadaji praises Kabir's efforts of rescuing Bunty. Kabir informs Nisha about his plan of ruining his image in front of the Gangwals. Nisha confronts Bunty for spending his tuition fees at a video game store. Sumit informs Rupan about Nisha's contract marriage with Kabir and searches Kabir's house for documents.

episodesList.title: Rupan-Sumit Gang Up
episodesList.summary: Sumit steals the contract document from Kabir's cupboard. Dadi tries to calm Laxmi. Dadaji informs Kabir about the jewellery manufacturing factory and asks him to take the responsibility. Rupan and Sumit discuss their plan against Kabir!

episodesList.title: Sumit Has Nisha's Marriage Papers
episodesList.summary: Dolly informs Sumit about Dadaji offering him a job at the Gangwal jewellers. Sumit tells Leela about their plan against the Gangwals. He informs a property dealer, Shekhawat about his plan against Kabir. Kabir gives a cheque to Shekhawat. Sumit shows Nisha and Kabir's contract marriage document.

episodesList.title: Kabir Asked To House-Hunt!
episodesList.summary: Laxmi and Dadaji enquire with Nisha on seeing Viraj at her house. Viraj reveals to Dadaji that Nisha is his tenant. Ramesh is upset with Kabir for staying at Viraj's house. Dadaji asks Kabir to search for a new house. Kabir apologises to Nisha for his rude behaviour.

episodesList.title: Sumit Conspires Against Kabir
episodesList.summary: Ramesh apologises to Dadaji and Dadi on Kabir's behalf. Sumit informs Rupan about his plan. Viraj apologises to Nisha. Dolly informs Vimla and Virendra about her interview. Sumit asks his associates to attack Kabir. Virendra gives Rs 2 lakh to Kabir to give it to Shekhawat.

episodesList.title: Viraj Rescues Kabir
episodesList.summary: Sumit's associates attack Kabir. Kabir thanks Viraj Singh Rathod for rescuing him from the goons. Dolly confronts Sumit for his misbehaviour. Sumit informs Leela about his plan against Kabir. Nisha, Ramesh and Laxmi are shattered on seeing Kabir injured. Kabir informs Nisha about being rescued.

episodesList.title: Sumit Provokes Viraj
episodesList.summary: Kabir is happy to inform Nisha about joining the London School of Dance. Sumit provokes Viraj against Kabir. Nisha asks Viraj to meet a doctor. Kabir apologises to Dadaji for his mistake. Sumit lies to Kabir about Viraj paying the goons to attack him.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Confronts Kabir
episodesList.summary: Saurabh informs Dolly about being an entrepreneur. Dolly informs Saurabh that Sumit has lost his job. She tells Saurabh about her interview at a school. Ramesh confronts Kabir for his rude behaviour towards Virendra. Sumit informs the school officials that Dolly does not want to work as a librarian.

episodesList.title: Kabir Signs The Property Papers
episodesList.summary: Dolly confronts Sumit for lying to the school officials. Sumit's associate and a property dealer, Mr Agarwal sells Viraj's land to Kabir. Kabir signs the property papers. Ramesh tells Laxmi about his plan of surprising Kabir and Nisha. Sumit gives the property papers to Viraj.

episodesList.title: Nisha Reveals Her Marriage Truth
episodesList.summary: Ramesh, Nisha and Kabir become anxious when Laxmi gets a panic attack. Kabir tells Nisha about revealing their contract marriage to Ramesh and Laxmi. Dolly agrees to be Saurabh's business partner. Nisha apologises to Laxmi for her mistake and informs Saurabh about her contract marriage with Kabir!

episodesList.title: Sumit And Leela Steal Jewellery!
episodesList.summary: Saurabh decides to play a prank on Nisha and asks Suketu to bring an astrologer to Nisha's house. Sumit and Leela discuss their plan. The astrologer predicts Nisha's future. Sumit and Leela steal the real jewellery and replace them with fake ornaments.

episodesList.title: Saurabh Gets His First Order
episodesList.summary: Sumit helps Leela to escape from the warehouse. Kabir confronts Nisha for not revealing about their contract marriage to Laxmi. Saurabh informs Suketu, Amanpreet and Jwala about his partnership with Dolly. He tells them that he has got their first business order.

episodesList.title: Nisha In Love With Kabir!
episodesList.summary: Kabir apologises to Nisha for his misbehaviour. Nisha makes fun of Kabir. Kabir assures Nisha of not forcing her to reveal the truth about their marriage to her family. Nisha tells her cousins that she is in love with Kabir!

episodesList.title: Nisha Decides To Propose Kabir
episodesList.summary: Leela hauls up Dolly for insulting Sumit. Nisha informs her cousins about her plan to propose to Kabir on his birthday. Nisha's cousins decide to throw a surprise birthday party for Kabir. Sumit informs Leela about his plan against Kabir.

episodesList.title: Nisha Confronts Leela
episodesList.summary: Nisha decides to gift a camera to Kabir on his birthday. Later, an infuriated Sumit confronts Dolly on seeing her with Saurabh. Leela pretends to care for Kabir and lies to Vimla about him. Nisha confronts Leela for misbehaving with Kabir. Later, Kabir assures Dolly that he will complete her order.

episodesList.title: Nisha Wishes Kabir
episodesList.summary: Sumit and Leela discuss their plan against Kabir. Kabir tries to motivate Dolly. Nisha wishes Kabir on his birthday. Later, Kabir shares his miseries with Nisha.

episodesList.title: Saurabh Suspects Sumit
episodesList.summary: Dolly and Saurabh are delighted when Kabir informs them about their business order. Nisha's cousins wish Kabir on his birthday. Saurabh informs Kabir about finding his diary near Sumit's room. He spies on Sumit. Viraj informs Ramesh about Nisha's contract marriage with Kabir.

episodesList.title: Kabir's Birthday!
episodesList.summary: Viraj tells Ramesh that Nisha is unhappy with her marriage, but Ramesh refuses to believe him. Nisha and her cousins organise a surprise birthday party for Kabir. Nemichand stops Ramesh from going to Nisha's house. Sumit robs Viraj and flees locking him inside. Nisha and Kabir have a wonderful time.

episodesList.title: Nisha Warns Sumit
episodesList.summary: Nisha and Kabir share a moment. Sumit meets Ramesh on his way back from Viraj's house. Later, he visits Kabir on his birthday. Nisha finds Sumit misbehaving with Dolly. Viraj thinks about getting Nisha back. Nisha spills hot coffee over Sumit's hand and warns him to behave himself.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Confronts Nisha-Kabir
episodesList.summary: Ramesh confronts Nisha and Kabir about their marriage. He tells them about knowing the truth from Viraj. Nisha begs Ramesh for forgiveness. Saurabh flees from the house. Kabir regrets coming back into Nisha's life. Nisha returns to her home.

episodesList.title: Leela Tries To Frame Saurabh
episodesList.summary: Nisha hides the truth from her cousins. Nemichand holds Kabir and Nisha responsible for the fake jewellery. Saurabh arrives and reveals about Sumit being the culprit. Leela slyly slips the jewellery into Saurabh's bag and tries to frame him. Nisha recalls seeing the jewellery with Leela.

episodesList.title: Nisha Has 24 Hours!
episodesList.summary: Sumit tries to frame Kabir and Saurabh to escape the allegations against him. Virender informs Nemichand about Kabir being the last person to leave the warehouse and also about building the factory on Viraj's property. Nisha demands for 24 hours to prove Kabir innocent. She gets upset with Saurabh.

episodesList.title: Kabir-Viraj Get Into A Fight
episodesList.summary: Viraj calls Aman to reach out to Nisha. Leela and Sumit pretend to be good with Dolly in front of Virender. Viraj tries to convince Nisha of his innocence. Kabir gets into a fight with Viraj for calling him a fraud. Nisha pleads with Viraj to leave.

episodesList.title: Nisha-Kabir Look For Evidence
episodesList.summary: Nemichand shares his grief with Vimala. Kabir decides to check the CCTV footage of the nearby warehouse. Rukmavati finds Sumit in the temple, late at night. Sumit clicks Saurabh's photograph seeing him in Dolly's room. Nisha suggests Kabir and her cousins to search for the jewellery in the house.

episodesList.title: Kabir Confronts Sumit
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Nisha search for the jewellery in the house. Nisha informs Dolly about the CCTV footage. Dolly and Nisha find the jewellery in the temple. Later, Nisha is shattered when Dolly lies to her. Dadaji tells Nisha that the Gangwals will break their relationship with Kabir, if he is found guilty.

episodesList.title: Sumit Challenges Kabir-Nisha
episodesList.summary: A dejected Dolly confronts Sumit for forcing her to lie to her family. Later, a furious Virendra asks Ramesh to get Kabir arrested. Laxmi tries to prove Kabir's innocence to Virendra. Meanwhile, Sumit challenges Kabir and Nisha to find the jewellery.

episodesList.title: Kabir Disguises Himself
episodesList.summary: Kabir thinks of ways to find the jewellery. He gets inside Viraj's house, disguised as an electrician and finds Nisha's photograph. Nisha enquires with Dolly about Sumit. Nisha overhears Sumit's conversation about meeting someone with the jewellery.

episodesList.title: Nisha Foils Sumit's Deal
episodesList.summary: Laxmi is worried about Nisha. Dolly receives Saurabh's letter. She informs Nisha about Sumit's plan to mislead them. Nisha follows Sumit and foils his deal with the buyers. Sumit tries to get away with the evidence which Nisha has against him.

episodesList.title: Nisha Loses Consciousness!
episodesList.summary: Sumit pushes Nisha and she falls off a building and loses consciousness. Viraj and Kabir admit Nisha to a hospital. The doctor informs Kabir about Nisha having to undergo an operation. Dolly slaps Sumit for his misdeed against Nisha. Leela asks Sumit to ruin the evidence against them.

episodesList.title: Kabir Manages To Escape
episodesList.summary: Viraj accuses Kabir of trying to kill Nisha. Vimla and Dadaji refuse to believe Dolly. Viraj returns the jewellery to Virendra. Kabir attacks Sumit at the hospital. Suketu and Laxmi try to prove Kabir's innocence. Kabir escapes before the cops could arrest him.

episodesList.title: Kabir Asks Dolly For Help
episodesList.summary: Dadaji asks Sumit to take the jewellery to their shop. Dolly confronts Leela for accusing Kabir. She informs her cousins about Sumit and Leela's misdeed. Kabir asks for Dolly's help to prove Sumit's misdeed. Dolly helps Kabir to enter the Gangwal House. Viraj tries to calm Ramesh.

episodesList.title: Nisha Needs Blood; Sumit Can Help
episodesList.summary: Kabir and Dolly learn about the evidence Nisha has against Sumit. The doctor informs Laxmi and Suketu that Nisha needs blood. Kabir vows to prove his innocence and assaults Sumit. Sumit offers to donate blood to Nisha, if Kabir takes the blame on himself!

episodesList.title: Kabir Takes The Blame
episodesList.summary: Sumit agrees to donate blood to Nisha after Kabir agrees to his conditions. The doctor informs Laxmi that he has failed to find blood for Nisha. Kabir asks Dolly to tell the Gangwals that Sumit is innocent. Sumit donates blood to Nisha. Kabir takes the blame and surrenders to the police.

episodesList.title: Nisha Regains Consciousness
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Kabir. Dolly tells her family that Sumit is innocent. On regaining consciousness, Nisha asks Laxmi and Ramesh about Kabir. Virendra informs Nisha about Kabir's arrest. Nisha tells Laxmi how Sumit pushed her off the building. Sumit tells Nisha that he has destroyed her phone.

episodesList.title: Nisha Seeks Viraj's Help
episodesList.summary: Sumit and Leela are happy to see their plan against Kabir succeed. Meanwhile, Laxmi is frightened learning that Nisha is missing from the hospital. Nisha informs Ramesh about Sumit destroying her phone. She seeks Viraj's help to prove Kabir's innocence.

episodesList.title: Saurabh Blackmails Sumit
episodesList.summary: Nisha denies Viraj's allegations on Kabir. Saurabh and Umesh visit Nisha. Umesh suggests of creating a plan against Sumit. Saurabh blackmails Sumit with the tampered evidence against him and asks him to meet outside the shop. Kabir hopes for Nisha to help him get out of jail.

episodesList.title: Nisha's Plan To Expose Sumit
episodesList.summary: Ramesh pretends to be Sumit and calls Leela to learn about their plan. Saurabh pretends to care for Sumit and apologises to him. Sumit decides to change his plan as he suspects the Gangwals of having learnt about it. Ramesh and Suketu disguise as buyers and take the jewellery from Sumit.

episodesList.title: The Police Arrest Sumit And Leela
episodesList.summary: Ramesh confronts Sumit for his misdeed against the Gangwals. The police arrest Sumit and Leela. Viraj slaps Sumit for deceiving him. The Gangwals are delighted as Kabir returns home. Kabir apologises to Dadaji for his mistake.

episodesList.title: Kabir Moving To London?
episodesList.summary: Nemichand and Ramesh thank Saurabh for his help. Virender refuses to forgive Kabir and Nisha. Nisha consoles a heartbroken Dolly. Virender argues with Ramesh alleging Kabir to be a traitor. Viraj informs Nisha about Kabir's plan to move to London and shows his ticket to her.

episodesList.title: Virendra Bails Out Sumit
episodesList.summary: Nisha worries about Kabir moving to London. Kabir fails to propose to Nisha. Leela reveals about Dolly's pregnancy to the Gangwals. Dolly is worried as Leela wants Sumit to be released from jail. Later, the Gangwals are shocked when Virendra brings Sumit home.

episodesList.title: Dolly Breaks Up With Sumit
episodesList.summary: Sumit pretends to care for Dolly. Virendra confronts Kabir for provoking the family against Sumit. Later, Nisha tries to prove Kabir's innocence to Virendra. Dolly breaks her relationship with Sumit. Leela and Sumit leave the Gangwal House. Nisha informs Virendra about Sumit's misdeed against Dolly.

episodesList.title: Virendra Confronts Ramesh, Mohan
episodesList.summary: Virendra confronts Ramesh and Mohan for having alcohol. Kabir informs Nisha about the mail from London School of Dance and his registration form. Laxmi informs Ramesh that Kabir is in love with Nisha. Meanwhile, Vasundhara books a room at a hotel.

episodesList.title: Nisha Apologises To Vasundhara
episodesList.summary: Kabir asks the London School of Dance to cancel his admission. He tells Ramesh that he is in love with Nisha. Nisha apologises to Vasundhara for her mistake. Later, Nisha introduces herself to Vasundhara and takes her home. Kabir asks the Gangwals to allow Dolly to work with Saurabh.

episodesList.title: Kabir Decides To Propose To Nisha
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara tells Nisha that she wanted to become a singer. Meanwhile, Dadaji suggests Dolly to work with Saurabh in the handloom business. Ramesh praises Kabir for his efforts. Vasundhara tells Nisha that she is looking for her son. Kabir decides to profess his love to Nisha.

episodesList.title: Dolly Agrees To Work With Saurabh
episodesList.summary: Nisha asks Saurabh to convince Dolly to work with him. Saurabh admits to his love for Dolly. Dolly agrees to work with him. The inspector informs Vasundhara that Virendra has lodged a false complaint against Kabir. Ramesh asks Kabir to profess his love to Nisha.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Lies To Kabir
episodesList.summary: Kabir tries to propose to Nisha, however, Vasundhara spoils the moment. Vasundhara slaps Kabir. Kabir apologises to Vasundhara for lying to her and stops Nisha from revealing about their marriage. Kabir asks Vasundhara about his brother. However, she lies saying he is dead!

episodesList.title: Kabir-Nisha's Marriage Revealed!
episodesList.summary: Leela pretends to be sad in front of Vimla and Laxmi. Vimla confronts Dolly for misbehaving with Leela. Meanwhile, Kabir thanks Nisha for helping him. Vaundhara gifts a sari to Nisha. Later, Nisha introduces Laxmi to Vasundhara. Kabir reveals to Vasundhara about his marriage with Nisha.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Gifts Bangles To Nisha
episodesList.summary: Nisha and Kabir apologise to Vasundhara for lying to her about their marriage. Nisha thanks Vasundhara for forgiving them. Later, Vasundhara gifts bangles to Nisha. Dolly tells Nisha that Kabir loves her. Kabir informs Vasundhara that he does not want to go to London.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara, Ramesh Are Old Pals
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara tells Kabir that she knows the Gangwals. She tells Laxmi and Vimla that she and Ramesh are childhood friends. Later, Vasundhara tells Dadaji about Kabir being her son. She tells Nisha about her relationship with the Gangwals. Dolly lets Vasundhara know that Sumit is in jail.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara's Hidden Motives
episodesList.summary: Ramesh apologises to Vasundhara for his mistake and tells her that they must help Kabir and Nisha to profess their love to each other. Later, Vasundhara vows to ruin Nisha's life. Nisha makes fun of Kabir. Kabir and Nisha are worried as Vasundhara suffers an asthma attack.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Lies About Ramesh
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara informs Kabir that she was in love with Ramesh. She lies to Kabir that Ramesh deceived her. Meanwhile, Ramesh informs Laxmi about his relationship with Vasundhara. Dolly thanks Saurabh for supporting her. Kabir informs Vasundhara that he wants to go on a holiday with Nisha.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara, Leela Make A Deal
episodesList.summary: Dadaji asks Ramesh to help him renew the lease of their shop. Vasundhara informs Leela that she will get Sumit out of jail, if she gives her the balance sheet of the Gangwal Jewellers. Vasundhara informs Dadaji that she will sign the lease papers, if he agrees to give her 60% of the profit.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Wants To Ruin Nisha
episodesList.summary: Ramesh informs Vasundhara that the Gangwals want to buy her land. He apologises to Vasundhara for his mistake. Later, Vasundhara tells Ramesh that she will avenge her insult by ruining Nisha's life. She refuses to renew the lease of their shop. Kabir confronts Ramesh for misbehaving with Vasundhara.

episodesList.title: Nisha Confronts Kabir
episodesList.summary: Vasundhara pretends to care for Nisha. Nisha is shocked on seeing Viraj. Leela eavesdrops on Nisha's conversation with Viraj. Later, Nisha confronts Kabir for accusing Ramesh. Vasundhara plans to ruin Nisha's relationship with Kabir. Leela locks Nisha and Viraj in a room.

episodesList.title: Vimla Apologises To Leela
episodesList.summary: Kabir asks Nisha to stay away from him. Later, Vasundhara tries to provoke Kabir against Nisha. Leela sends a message from Nisha's phone to Viraj, asking him to meet her. Vimla confronts Dolly for misbehaving with Leela. Vasundhara suggests Nisha to take Kabir out for a surprise dinner.

episodesList.title: Nisha Decides To Propose Kabir
episodesList.summary: Kabir informs Vasundhara that he has spoken to a few brokers about buying a rented house. Nisha decides to profess her love to Kabir. Kabir sees Nisha with Viraj. Nisha tells Viraj that she had not sent the message to him. Vasundhara asks Kabir to forget Nisha and tries to provoke him against Viraj.

episodesList.title: Kabir Decides To Go To London
episodesList.summary: Nisha confronts Kabir for his strange behaviour. A dejected Kabir informs Viraj that Nisha still loves him and asks him to care for her. Later, Kabir tells Nisha that he wants to go to London. Nisha informs Ramesh that Kabir is leaving for London. Nisha eavesdrops on Kabir's conversation with Viraj.

episodesList.title: Nisha To Stop Kabir From Leaving
episodesList.summary: Ramesh gives his share of the profit to Vasundhara and requests her to stop Kabir from leaving. Nisha shares her miseries with her cousins. Ramesh decides to stop Kabir from leaving. Nisha's cousins ask her to stop Kabir. Ramesh, Nisha and Vasundhara look for Kabir at the railway station.

episodesList.title: Ramesh Confronts Leela
episodesList.summary: Kabir informs Vasundhara that the London Dance School is reconsidering his admission. Nisha is upset as Kabir leaves Jaipur. Later, Nisha confronts Ramesh and Vasundhara for arguing with each other. Vasundhara lies to Ramesh that she tried to stop Kabir. Ramesh confronts Leela for insulting Nisha.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Misleads Kabir
episodesList.summary: Saurabh tells Jwala and Dolly to not worry about Nisha. Meanwhile, Nisha confronts Leela as she speaks ill about Kabir. Later, a thief tries to steal Kabir's jacket from Nisha, but she puts up a fight. Vasundhara misleads Kabir about Nisha. On the other hand, Nisha believes that Kabir does not love her.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Learn Kabir's Lie
episodesList.summary: Viraj realises that Nisha loves Kabir and she would be happy with him. Kabir thinks about Nisha and gets upset. Vasundhara fumes learning that Kabir hasn't renewed his admission in London University and is currently residing at Jaipur. She calls Ramesh and lies about Kabir. Later, Dolly falls ill.

episodesList.title: Dolly Wants A Divorce
episodesList.summary: Dolly returns home with Saurabh. Seeing Dolly ill, Virendra gets disturbed and rebukes her. Dolly announces to her family about her decision to file for a divorce. Meanwhile, Saurabh confesses that he wants to marry Dolly. Later, Ramesh informs Nisha about the divorce papers, which Kabir has sent.

episodesList.title: Viraj Is Vasundhara's Son!
episodesList.summary: Nisha misunderstands Viraj and rebukes him. Viraj enquires with his lawyer about Nisha and Kabir's divorce notice. Meanwhile, Vasundhara learns about Viraj being her own son. She realises that she misused him for Nisha and Kabir's divorce. Kabir is disheartened getting the divorce notice from Nisha.

episodesList.title: Nisha's Upset About The Notice!
episodesList.summary: Viraj rebukes Vasundhara for her misdeeds. Vasundhara gets emotional and faints. Kabir finds her unconscious and learns that Viraj is responsible for it. Elsewhere, Nisha is depressed regarding her divorce notice. Later, Dolly confesses to her family that she feels for Saurabh.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Corrects Everything
episodesList.summary: Kabir goes to Viraj's house and blames him for Vasundhara's illness. Vasundhara confesses to her misdeed in front of Nisha and discloses Viraj's identity. Nisha reveals the same to Kabir and Viraj. Later, Viraj apologises to Nisha's family and hands over the property papers to Kabir.

episodesList.title: Kabir Proposes Nisha, Once Again
episodesList.summary: Nisha talks to Saurabh about Dolly. Virendra confronts Leela for insulting Dolly. Vasundhara confesses to the Gangwals about stealing the accounts file with Leela's help. She apologises to Kabir for her misdeed. Saurabh assures Dolly of taking care of her. Kabir proposes to Nisha.

plotHtml:
Set against the backdrop of Jaipur, it showcases the unconventional bond among seven cousins - Umesh, the oldest amongst the cousins whose passion is cooking; Dolly, a soon-to-be-married shopaholic and her fiancé Sumit; Kirti, a slightly narcissistic, self-involved fashionista; Nisha, a tomboy and a daredevil at heart; Suketu, an aspiring actor; Jwala, smart, painfully shy loveable geek; and Bunty, the youngest among all the cousins, and a typical mischief-maker, living in a joint family consisting of three brothers, their wives, Grandpa and Grandma.
Grandpa is a strict man who loves his grandchildren but believes in discipline and traditions. His ideals and mindset differ from the cousins' and the concept "Friends are forever, Cousins are for life!".
Despite their differing personalities, the cousins are linked together by a common thread of love and friendship and are each other's support system. Saurav, their childhood friend, is also a part of the cousins' gang.
The cousins sort through all the troubles that crop up during Dolly's wedding (that they themselves inevitably caused) and ensure she marries Sumit.
Umesh wants to open his own restaurant but is scared of his father who wants him to continue their family business. Suketu's dream of becoming an actor is not supported by Dadaji and he too is made to join the family business. Kirti breaks her relationship with her fiancé, Ritesh, after learning of his selfish motives. Jwala's tuition teacher tries to misbehave with her but she's saved by Nisha, which leads to the revelation that Nisha was a victim of child abuse when she was thirteen, after which she became a tomboy.
Nisha becomes inspired by Viraj Singh Rathore, a national level shooter and joins his Lakshya Academy as an office assistant. She writes mails to him in the name of Aarti to help him come out of his loneliness. Meanwhile, Umesh's girlfriend's - Amanpreet's father passes away, motivating Umesh to take a stand against his family and announce that he wants to marry Amanpreet, which is not received well by the elders who want Umesh to marry a Jain. Viraj and Amanpreet develop a brother-sister bond. After a few incidents, Umesh and Amanpreet marry with the family's consent.
The whole truth of Nisha being Aarti is presented in a bad way in front of media at a press conference by Viraj's bua Gayatri, abusing Viraj and Nisha's relationship. Viraj is left shattered.
After facing harsh words from Viraj, a heart-broken Nisha decides to go on a trip alone to discover herself where she meets Kabir (an artist who earns money from photography) who has come to Jaipur from Dubai in search of his brother, whom he has never met. While trying to save a little girl Chandu and themselves from the goons, both end up getting married accidentally and again marry unwillingly in front of Nisha's family due to Grandpa's insistence. They mutually agree on a contract marriage of three months after which Kabir would go to London, to fulfill his dream of becoming a world renowned dancer. Ramesh decides to follow his passion and opts out of the family business and starts his own music class.
Sumit gets jealous of the growing fondness of the family for Kabir and plots against him along with his mom and Rupan and traps him in a fake jewellery case. But while Nisha along with her cousins plans to clear Kabir's name while Nisha meets with an accident because of Sumit and is hospitalised and Kabir is imprisoned. After regaining conscious Nisha and her cousins along with Ramesh and Lakshmi proves Kabir's innocence and convict Sumit for his crimes. Kabir and Nisha realise they are in love with each other but do not confess. Meanwhile, Kaira reveals Gayatri's truth and Viraj realises his mistake of not trusting Nisha and also that he loves her and tries to get her back in his life.
Kabir's mom Vasundhara comes down to India and reprimands her son for lying to her about him being in London and hiding about his marriage. Though she accepts the marriage initially, she vows to separate them as she learns that Nisha is a Gangwal as she hates the Gangwals due to some past issues. It is then shown that Viraj and Kabir are brothers and Vasundhara had to leave Viraj when he was a child due to circumstances. She uses Viraj to create misunderstandings between Nisha and Kabir without knowing that Viraj is her son. Kabir thinks that Nisha is still in love with Viraj and decides to leave to London. Vasundhara gets to know that Viraj is her son, realises her mistake and asks Nisha to reunite the brothers. Viraj and Kabir reunite. Viraj realises that Nisha loves Kabir and decides to move on. Vasundhara apologizes to everyone and decides to be with Viraj. In the meantime, Dolly gets to know that she's pregnant but decides to raise her baby alone and applies for divorce from Sumit.
The story ends with Saurav and Dolly's love confession, Kabir proposing Nisha and their happy reunion with the cousins and the whole Gangwal family rejoicing and a flashback of all their happy moments is shown with the cousins theme song, Firdausiyana plays in the background.

title: Nadaan Parindey Ghar Aaja
summary: Nadaan Parindey Ghar Aaja is an Indian drama television series that aired on Life OK. It premiered on 7 April 2014.
plot:
Sameer Atwal and his family live near the India-Pakistan border. A happy-go-lucky young man, Sameer's life takes a 180-degree turn when he joins the Indian army. Although Sameer joins the army to be able to marry his beloved Meher, he is quickly sent to war against Pakistan. In the war, his brother Purab shoots and kills him because he is also in love with Meher.
Sameer is sent back to the India-Pakistan border after 6 months. Purab doubts that "Sameer" is the real Sameer, but everyone else is convinced. Purab's doubts are confirmed, and Sameer is not the real Sameer. Instead, the impostor, Iqbal, was sent by Pakistan's Agent Malik on a secret mission. Iqbal gradually falls in love with Meher. However, Malik orders Iqbal to kill Meher as she is an obstacle to Iqbal's mission. Iqbal feels conflicted about his love for Meher and his mission. Purab confesses his love to Meher, but she rejects him to marry "Sameer" (Iqbal) the next day.
Bebe then realizes that the man she loves is not her real son, but has her son's face. Iqbal, as Sameer, takes Meher to the temple and marries her. Iqbal begins to torture Bebe not to tell this truth to anyone otherwise the real Sameer, who is imprisoned, will be killed in Pakistan. Purab plays with Minty to get revenge on Meher, as he knows that Minty likes him.
Soon, Iqbal's father in Pakistan goes to visit his son in Jail. He visits Sameer, mistakenly thinking Sameer is Iqbal. He then calls Iqbal in India and informs him that Iqbal and Sameer are actually twins and that Bebe is actually both Sameer's and Iqbal's birth mother. Iqbal feels guilty for torturing Bebe and for what he did with Meher.
He decides to bring Sameer back from Pakistan, but first he apologizes to Meher and they consummate their marriage. Iqbal leaves the following night for Pakistan. Meher and Bebe try to stop him but in vain. Iqbal reaches the jail where Sameer is and with the help of their father they switch places. Sameer returns to India and is devastated to learn that Meher loves Iqbal. However, they resume their friendship and try to adjust.
They learn on the news that Iqbal has been hanged as a traitor. Meher is devastated as she is pregnant with Iqbal's child. Sameer and Bebe take care of her during her pregnancy, but Meher dies during childbirth. Sameer and Bebe promise to take care of the baby, and they name him Iqbal.

They learn on the news that Iqbal has been hanged as a traitor. Meher is devastated as she is pregnant with Iqbal's child. Sameer and Bebe take care of her during her pregnancy, but Meher dies during childbirth. Sameer and Bebe promise to take care of the baby, and they name him Iqbal.

title: Numm
summary:
Numm (Urdu: نم) is a 2013 Pakistani drama serial that portrays social issues. It was directed by Ahson Talish, produced by Amjad Hashmi and written by Myra Sajid. The show stars Fawad Khan, Sania Saeed and Kanza Wayne.
The show tells the story of strict customs and rituals of feudal times and their impact. The plot revolves around three people: Wali Bakht Khan, Mahjabeen and Neelum. It shows the effect of unwise traditions and old customs on this triangle relationship. Numm aired on 24 August 2013 worldwide by Geo Entertainment. Ahson Talish also acted in small scenes as the father of the male protagonist (Fawad Khan). The theme song of drama gained popularity among fans and viewer. It received mixed reviews from the critics.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The Numm Drama serial was planned to go on-air in mid 2012 or early 2013, but due to cast selection and other technical issues, productions goes late. Ahson Talish son of Pakistani legendary actor late Agha Talish starts direction in late November 2012 and starts directing in early December with its assembled cast Fawad Khan, Sania Saeed and new up-comer and VJ, Kanza Wayne. Saeed took on the part because she believed her character was important and impactful, even though she wasn't the lead, and it was a story she could stand behind. The serial is produced by Agha Talish Productions and Q Link Productions. The serial is produced by Amjad Hashmi and co-produced by Ahson Talish's son Raza Talish and Tasneem Ahson. Ahson hired screenwriter Myra Sajid which starts her career as a playwright previously with Ahson's another project.

articleSections.title: Dramatization
articleSections.text: Ahson Talish began his direction in late December 2012 and finished it July 2013. Most of the drama was shot in Lahore and Abbottabad. Numm released its promos in late July until its airing.

articleSections.title: Original soundtrack
articleSections.text: The Theme song of Numm is its original soundtrack, written by Ahson Talish the director of serial, and composed by Muhammad Agha. The music is separately produced by Haider Hashmi and co-produced by Imran Khalil. The song is sung by talented Faiza Mujahid who rose to fame by Bandya Ho from the 2012 Critically acclaimed Pakistani movie Khuda Kay Liye. The lyrics were penned down by Ahson beautifully and gain a huge acclaim.
